metas.name: WWE SummerSlam
metas.description: This will be the first WWE stadium event held in Minneapolis and the second SummerSlam overall in the city, after the 1999 event, which took place at Target Center.

metas.name: The Prosecutor
metas.description: This raw docuseries is about the head of the new Femicide Investigation Unit in Mexico City, a department established to stop violence against women.

metas.name: Strip Law
metas.description: Too boring to win cases in Vegas, uptight lawyer Lincoln Gumb teams up with local illusionist/hedonist Sheila Flambé to bring flash and pizzazz to the stupidest cases that the city can throw at them.

metas.name: Salish & Jordan Matter
metas.description: Follow father and daughter Jordan and Salish through wild situations and extreme challenges in this compilation of classic family moments.

metas.name: To Love, To Lose
metas.description: A star-crossed romance seals the fate of two families when a woman trying to save her family restaurant falls for the surly heir of a debt collector.

metas.name: Must Date the Playboy!
metas.description: A fake relationship. A hidden agenda. A shy girl and a notorious playboy enter a dangerous game of love — where the biggest mistake they can make… is falling for each other.

metas.name: Kylie
metas.description: A look at the life of Australian pop star Kylie Minogue, who opens her personal archives and reflects on a career in which she has sold 80 million records and reinvented herself, and by extension pop, several times. Home movies, personal photographs and new interviews reveal the picture, as Kylie addresses how she’s faced public scrutiny, personal loss and illness.

metas.name: All the Truth in My Lies
metas.description: Coco and Marín, two best friends who have been living together for years. They are about to embark on a caravan trip with their entire gang to celebrate their friend Blanca's bachelorette party, but what should be an adventure celebrating friendship turns into a ticking time bomb as the secrets hidden among them gradually begin to unravel.

metas.name: Hot Ones: Extra Heat
metas.description: In this exclusive new series of specials, "Hot Ones: Extra Heat" challenges celebrity guests to answer spicy questions while eating even spicier wings.

metas.name: Mating Season
metas.description: Brings out the animal within to unleash our natural instincts in the pursuit of true love.

metas.name: Physical 100: Italy
metas.description: It follows 100 competitors, including many Italian VIPs, with races full of physical challenges, but which also require skills in terms of strategy and mental strength. Only one will be crowned the winner.

metas.name: Physical 100: Mexico
metas.description: Reality competition show adaptation of the Korean original format.

metas.name: Ricky Gervais Alley Cats
metas.description: Outrageous misadventures run wild as feral cats cause chaos on the streets in this no-holds-barred animated comedy from Ricky Gervais.

metas.name: Balaraw: Blood Island
metas.description: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

metas.name: Sold out on You
metas.description: A farmer with multiple jobs and an insomniac TV host's lives intertwine in amusing ways as their opposite schedules repeatedly bring them together.

metas.name: Can This Love Be Translated?
metas.description: The emotions of a celebrity and her interpreter get lost in translation as they travel the world filming a TV show. Will love find its own language?

metas.name: Elite Force
metas.description: France's top-tier police unit, GIGN, tackles high-stakes missions. These elite officers specialize in counterterrorism, rescuing hostages, and safeguarding government VIPs. They're the go-to force when national security is on the line.

metas.name: Wú Kê Tìdài
metas.description: The employee Xu Chi lives by the motto: "I must never be replaceable." She faces professional challenges, fights side by side with partner Ye Xinzhi, and becomes truly irreplaceable.

metas.name: Agent Kim Reactivated
metas.description: Manager Kim was an ordinary head of a household with a daughter and lived as a small citizen. In order to find his daughter, who is his everything, he reveals a secret that should never be revealed to the world.

metas.name: Free Bert
metas.description: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby crowd at their elite new school.

metas.name: Habeas Corpus
metas.description: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

metas.name: The Early Spring
metas.description: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

metas.name: LOVED ONE
metas.description: "Goodbye" is something that could happen to anyone tomorrow. And the feelings that remain afterwards. Through the serious subject of "forensic medicine," it carefully captures the feelings of love for others and the time they lived, quietly shedding light on the darkness of a "society where the cause of death is unknown".

metas.name: 100 Days of Deception
metas.description: Hoping for freedom, Gyeongseong's top pickpocket infiltrates the Japanese colonial government to steal secrets — only to fall for her target's son.

metas.name: Spooky in Love
metas.description: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.

metas.name: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
metas.description: Yuru, a young hunter, lives in a small village deep in the mountains, hunting wild game and leading a humble life with Asa, his younger twin sister. Their peaceful lives are torn apart when a dragon’s roar echoes across the sky. What secrets lurk within their village? What fate awaits them?

metas.name: The American Experiment
metas.description: A documentary examining the origins of American democracy and the concept of self-rule, featuring insights from politicians, scholars, judges, Indigenous leaders, and commentators representing various political viewpoints.

metas.name: Gordon
metas.description: A former car thief moves with his wife and infant son to a new home, presenting himself as a gentleman businessman while secretly leading a gang in robberies and building hidden passageways to spy on his own family.

metas.name: Undercover Miss Hong
metas.description: A retro office comedy depicting the chaotic events that unfold in the late 1990s when Sammo Hung, a 30-year-old elite securities supervisor who only cares about work, goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate employee at a securities firm where suspicious money flows are detected.

metas.name: Hulk Hogan: Real American
metas.description: Terry Bollea became Hulk Hogan. This unfiltered documentary reveals the man behind the legend through his final interview.

metas.name: Ashes to Crown
metas.description: The general's daughter, Chu Zhao, refuses to accept her fate as nothing more than a pawn to be sacrificed in Xiao Xun's rise to power. Taking matters into her own hands, she fights her way out with the help of Xie Yanlai, protecting the emperor's grandson as he makes his way to the emperor's presence. Through a tense standoff in the imperial court, she helps the young prince secure the throne, cutting off Xiao Xun's path to power. But with a new emperor comes new crises. The realm is torn by internal strife and foreign threats. Working alongside Xie Yanlai, Chu Zhao navigates the treacherous currents of the court, leads troops into battle, and ultimately rewrites her own destiny, sparing the people of the State of Chu from the ravages of war.

metas.name: Veil of Shadows
metas.description: Lu Wuyi, the youngest nine-tailed fox of the mysterious Formless Moon Sect, sets out on a mission with her friend Wu Wangyan to track down a fox demon on the run, Xiaowei. She infiltrates the Wei Mansion in Luo'an City, where she later crosses paths with Wu Shiguang, who holds a deep grudge, as well as Ji Ling and Li Jie, demon hunters from the Shilin Sect. In the process of uncovering the truth, they navigate between suspicion and cooperation, each driven by their own agendas. In their repeated struggles over the Dragon Deity's Power, their fates are changed time and again. To preserve peace in the world, they make painful sacrifices and ultimately subdue Jiu Ying, the lord of all demons, thus fulfilling an enduring quest of love and redemption.

metas.name: Buried Bones
metas.description: A history and true crime podcast featuring journalist Kate Winkler Dawson and retired investigator Paul Holes, who dissect the most compelling cases from centuries ago.

metas.name: Tatsuki: Too Kind for School
metas.description: A "free school" refers to a school that provides an alternative educational space and is free from the constraints found in traditional Japanese education system. It is primarily for students who stopped attending regular school for various reasons. Tatsuki Ukita is a principal of free school "Yukanai" and is known for being "extremely lenient" with children. He gets closer to the children through arts and games, and helps them uncover the feelings locked deep within their hearts.

metas.name: Reborn
metas.description: After being pushed down the stairs, CEO Kosei wakes up 14 years in the past. Now, he goes by the name Eito, works at a laundry, and must uncover who killed him.

metas.name: MOURINHO
metas.description: This trophy-packed, insider-fuelled documentary charts José Mourinho's iconic rise as one of the world's top footballing managers of the most elite clubs.

metas.name: Being Gordon Ramsay
metas.description: Follows Gordon Ramsay's journey to launch dining concepts at 22 Bishopsgate, London's second tallest building..

metas.name: Alkhallat+: The Series: Desert Rules
metas.description: Spanning from the desert to the city, this offbeat comedy anthology tells unique tales of desire, ambition - and those tempted enough to seek them out.

metas.name: Outlast: The Jungle
metas.description: On a remote tropical island, 16 players must survive the elements, outmaneuver rivals and remain part of a team for a chance to win a $1 million prize.

metas.name: Hello Bachhon
metas.description: A physics teacher sets out to make quality education accessible to all students through online learning.

metas.name: The Witness
metas.description: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

metas.name: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
metas.description: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

metas.name: Take a Hike!
metas.description: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

metas.name: Calabasas Confidential
metas.description: Fresh out of college, a tight-knit group of friends, exes, and rivals returns to hillside SoCal luxury and unfinished drama.

metas.name: Delusion
metas.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

metas.name: Class Crush Crisis
metas.description: Lee-ith, an aspiring indie rocker who neglects his studies, transfers to a formerly all-girls school now admitting boys. There he's paired as a roommate with Putter, a serious student—and the two clash from day one.

metas.name: TYSON
metas.description: Explores Mike Tyson's rise as a boxing champion, his personal struggles including incarceration, substance abuse, and controversies, and his eventual redemption looking at his polarizing life through the lens of his growth and maturity.

metas.name: Alicia's Law
metas.description: After her husband, a Supreme Court Justice Minister, is imprisoned for corruption, Alicia must restart her law career to support her children and pay bills as her world crumbles.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Trina Vega comes back to teach at Hollywood's premier performing arts school, where she was once a student.

metas.name: Anaesthesia
metas.description: After a bold but unsuccessful surgery, a talented doctor swaps a prestigious clinic for a local hospital as he tries to get his life back on track.

metas.name: Not A Stranger
metas.description: This psychological drama centers on Funda, a painter who took a break after childbirth. She finally finds the nanny she has been searching for, but the mysterious and unsettling nature of the new arrival, Nazli, begins to change the lives of Funda and her husband Ilker forever. What starts as a simple employment arrangement turns into a dangerous game of loyalty and desire.

metas.name: Brasil 70: A Saga do Tri
metas.description: Soccer icons Pele, Jarzinho, and Carlos Alberto spearhead Brazil's quest for World Cup glory. Their journey blends on-field brilliance with off-field challenges, capturing the spirit of a nation as they aim for soccer's ultimate prize.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Charles Manson Tapes
metas.description: Follows cult leader Charles Manson's rise, the 1969 murders committed by the Manson Family, and the 1971 trial through unreleased prison recordings, firsthand accounts, and interviews.

metas.name: Big Mistakes
metas.description: Two directionless siblings are blackmailed into the world of organized crime.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: A group of misbehaving Catholic school girls experience prophetic visions after a dance-team initiation goes wrong, triggering mass hysteria throughout their town.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
metas.description: Gen Takasegawa, the first Japanese actor to play the lead role at London's Shakespeare’s Globe Theatre, has been unable to return to Japan for some time. After two years, he finally makes his way back home, only to find out that he is suddenly and completely forgotten by the entire world.

metas.name: A Couple of Lies
metas.description: Helene (Frida Gustavsson) and Carl (Fares Fares) trade their home in Stockholm's archipelago for a sun-drenched villa in Sicily, swapping lives for some weeks with Scarlett (Emma Appleton) and Adam (Jakob Oftebro); a couple they’ve never met. But as they settle into each other’s houses, unsettling details begin to surface. As secrets emerge and hidden betrayals come to light, what started as a picture‑perfect escape slowly warps into a twisted game of surveillance, manipulation and mistrust.

metas.name: Little House on the Prairie
metas.description: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.

metas.name: Minerva Academy
metas.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

metas.name: The Map of Longing
metas.description: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

metas.name: The Dinosaurs
metas.description: From the first dinosaurs to the last, this epic documentary series examines their 165 million years on Earth and the forces that shaped their evolution.

metas.name: Unfamiliar
metas.description: Hidden in the middle of Berlin, ex-spies Simon and Meret run the safe house called "The Nest." When a threat they thought was eliminated catches up with them again, they suddenly have to hide from hit men, Russian agents, the Federal Intelligence Service (BND), ex-lovers and a lot of people they have wronged—and try to keep their marriage intact at the same time.

metas.name: Jae-seok's B&B Rules!
metas.description: The guest is king — but so is the host! Yu Jae-seok opens his first B&B, where he runs things his way and treats guests to his signature games.

metas.name: Unicorn Academy: Secrets Revealed
metas.description: Sophia and friends return to Unicorn Academy where ancient secrets emerge, threatening Unicorn Island's balance. They face a perilous quest with hidden powers, betrayals, and dark forces. Magic, suspense, and twists await.

metas.name: Santita
metas.description: After being wheelchair-bound from a crash, María José "Santita" Cano left her love at the altar. 20 years later, his return makes her face her past choices and test the limits of her love.

metas.name: Bãhubali: The Torchbearer
metas.description: From production setbacks to financial crises, the "Baahubali" cast and crew recount the demanding journey behind the beloved epic film series.

metas.name: Gimbap and Onigiri
metas.description: A disillusioned former college track star working at a diner meets a tired Korean animation student struggling to find housing in Japan, and they instantly connect over an emotional moment involving a rice ball.

metas.name: Salcedo, Leather, and Boogaloo
metas.description: Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.

metas.name: Boyfriend on Demand
metas.description: Seo Mi-rae is worn out by work. Love? It's the last thing on her mind. But a virtual dating service sparks feelings — and maybe a real shot at romance.

metas.name: That Night
metas.description: When a young, naïve single mother gets embroiled in a murder during an island getaway, her sisters rush to help. But they only make things worse.

metas.name: Agatha Christie's Seven Dials
metas.description: England, 1925. At a lavish country house party, a practical joke appears to have gone horribly, murderously wrong. It will be up to the unlikeliest of sleuths—the fizzingly inquisitive Lady Eileen 'Bundle' Brent—to unravel a chilling plot that will change her life, cracking wide open the country house mystery.

metas.name: Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: Phantom Lawyer
metas.description: A timid lawyer who suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts teams up with a cold, elite attorney, and together they take on supernatural clients whose unfinished business reveals buried truths.

metas.name: Ronaldinho: The One and Only
metas.description: This series follows the life and career of Brazilian soccer star Ronaldinho, tracing his journey from young prodigy to global sports icon.

metas.name: Soda Master
metas.description: Three former middle school friends who reunited after 37 years to pursue the mystery behind their former club advisor's disappearance.

metas.name: Bass X Machina
metas.description: In a lawless Steampunk West filled with outlaws, machines, and supernatural threats, a father must serve as judge, jury, and executioner to protect his family-risking the loss of those he loves most.

metas.name: My Royal Nemesis
metas.description: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

metas.name: The TikTok Killer
metas.description: When Esther vanishes without a trace, her family is able to piece together her last movements thanks to José Jurado Montilla, a traveler who journeys across Spain sharing heartfelt videos of his trips on his TikTok account. But “Dynamite” Montilla – the last person to have been with Esther – hides a dark past

metas.name: The Gift of Deceit
metas.description: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

metas.name: Political Lupin
metas.description: A master thief infiltrates politics to slyly pull off the ultimate heist of corrupt political funds.

metas.name: Wild Rose
metas.description: Roosevelt aka "Rose," comes from a family of assassins that also happen to run a nonprofit organization. Behind the nonprofit facade is an elite, family-run, hired-gun agency known for taking down high-profile targets. Rose's life turns upside down when his wife and daughter mysteriously walk out of his life and disappear for months. Suspecting foul play, Rose embarks on a journey to uncover the truth, unraveling a web of secrets that force him to question his identity within his own family.

metas.name: Would You Rather: Decide to Survive
metas.description: Would You Rather be invisible or be able to fly? Fight one giant duck or 1000 tiny ducks? Eat a man-sized bean or a bean-sized man? This comedy game show will see two teams of some of Britain's funniest digital personalities compete in hilarious real-life challenges based on classic hypothetical Would You Rather decisions. These three simple words decide everything from what they eat to who they send home.

metas.name: This Is Not a Dating Show
metas.description: A live comedy and improvisation show, every episode of This Is Not A Dating Show brings together 100 singles who have been seriously unlucky in love. A difficult task, but nothing Galder Varas can't handle. And if nobody hooks up, at least we'll have had a laugh.

metas.name: Sisters
metas.description: When their patriarch drops dead, three sister-wives in a devout polygamist home are thrust into a world without rules. This darkly funny tale queers a conservative community in a way that's as revolutionary as it is hilarious.

metas.name: Hanzaisha
metas.description: Follows Shigetou Shuji, the sole survivor of a mass stabbing who is warned he has 10 days to live. Rescued by a detective and journalist, their investigation uncovers a conspiracy involving corporate malfeasance and political interference.

metas.name: Rosana: Mejor Vivir Sin Miedo
metas.description: There are stories that are born in silence... and end up being sung to the world. After 30 years of music, Rosana opens her story like never before. A series that reveals the person behind the songs. Dreams. Fragility. Resilience. A journey back to the origins, to the truth that lives in every chord. A unique opportunity to take a closer look at the life that inspired the music. Because there are paths we walk while singing... and others we share to give back to the world everything life has given us.

metas.name: This is Poly
metas.description:
We TV and All Reality have revealed the trailer and key art for This Is Poly, a new, unscripted series exploring the real lives of modern polyamorous relationships. The 8-episode series takes a first-of-its-kind look at the world of polyamory, following the lives of five wildly different polycules, interconnected groups of people in polyamorous relationships.

As they build lives and families outside traditional norms, the series dives into the emotional realities of jealousy, commitment, communication, and trust, testing every rule of love and redefining what it means to be a family. This Is Poly premieres Friday, May 29, at 9:30 pm Et/Pt, immediately following the season premiere of Love After Lockup at 8 pm Et/Pt.

metas.name: Adarsh Baal Vidyalaya
metas.description: A relaxed principal tries to reform a failing public school, triggering a messy transformation as misfit teachers work to repair the system one lesson at a time.

metas.name: Final Siren: Inside the AFL
metas.description: In one of the tightest seasons in AFL history, Final Siren follows seven of the game's biggest names - Marcus Bontempelli, Nat Fyfe, Max Gawn, Toby Greene, Touk Miller, Cam Rayner and Dayne Zorko - as public doubt, online abuse, injuries, ageing, suspensions, and fierce rivalries threaten to derail what could be their shot at Premiership glory in 2025.

metas.name: I Would Rather Die
metas.description: One cold night, misfit Archie gets bitten by a zombie and after briefly considering ending his life, he decides he's going to figure out what the hell is happening to his body. So, with the help of his only friend and his lifelong crush, Archie sets out to find a cure before he turns into a full-blown monster and kills everyone.

metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Jury Duty Presents
metas.description: Anthony, a real temp, is hired at Rockin' Grandma's Hot Sauce (a fake company) for its annual retreat - the final one for the company's CEO Doug before retirement. Doug's son Dougie Jr. struggles to prove his leadership abilities while a polished private-equity team courts the company for acquisition.

metas.name: Sidetrack Adventures
metas.description: Sidetrack Adventures explores abandoned ghost towns, forgotten places, and hidden history across the wild landscapes of the American West.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: A college-set romantic drama chronicling the unexpected love story between a music student and the university's star hockey player, exploring themes of love and the complexities of adulthood through deep friendships and enduring bonds.

metas.name: Honor Thy Mother
metas.description: After years of estrangement, a mother and daughter find themselves on opposite sides of a bitter contest for what each believes is rightfully hers. Old wounds resurface as they weigh whether to confront the past together or let it drive them further apart.

metas.name: Operation Fernsby
metas.description: Secret agent Isaac Fernsby bumbles through missions navigating his quirky family along the way.

metas.name: Jupiter Jones
metas.description: Starring Taja V. Simpson in the title role, the show follows her character, a sharp-witted lawyer and "fixer," as she navigates high-profile scandals and conspiracies while dealing with her own past.

metas.name: The CEO Club
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at powerhouse female CEOs, from Serena Williams to Winnie Harlow, as they navigate their empires across sports, fashion, beauty, music, and business ventures.

metas.name: Fist of the North Star: HOKUTO NO KEN
metas.description: In the year 199X, the world was engulfed in nuclear fire!! Yet...humanity somehow survived!! A lone man with seven scars on his chest emerges. His name is Kenshiro, heir to Hokuto Shinken. In a world where only the strong survive, Kenshiro forges a path with his iron fists!

metas.name: It's Not Like That
metas.description: Freshly divorced Lori and recently widowed minister Malcolm, friends with teens, navigate singlehood while questioning if their longstanding bond hints at a romantic future.

metas.name: DIY Dungeon
metas.description: Joey Mills and Fantasia Royale Gaga renovate a basement into a sex dungeon.

metas.name: Pelayo: Más Allá Del Límite
metas.description: An immersive, three-episode docuseries narrated in the first person by Pelayo Gayol, revealing the darkest side of drug trafficking, not as a distant phenomenon, but as a global system that transforms violence into a business. It's a journey of no return to the heart of a silent war where looking the other way is no longer an option. Gayol leaves his role as an instructor to try to understand the roots of the conflict from the frontlines.

metas.name: Grand Voyages
metas.description: Grand Voyages takes viewers around the world and behind the scenes on some of the world's most stunning ocean and river cruises.  From iconic ships to storied routes, we take you along on the world's most remarkable voyages and into a rarely seen world, to experience each journey from the inside out.

metas.name: Friends Sex and Games
metas.description: A group of friends starts a daring game. Everyone throws their keys into a bowl—whoever picks one spends the night with the owner of that key.

metas.name: Absolute Value of Romance
metas.description: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

metas.name: The Pyramid Scheme
metas.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

metas.name: Spider-Noir
metas.description: Ben Reilly, a seasoned, down-on-his-luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life, following a deeply personal tragedy, as the city's one and only superhero.

metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

metas.name: House for the Broken
metas.description: A pastor and his church become a refuge for people battling addiction, violence, grief, and the weight of their past as broken lives collide in a raw and honest exploration of faith, redemption, and second chances.

metas.name: The Darwin Incident
metas.description: Charlie is one of a kind. As a half-human, half-chimpanzee Humanzee, his intellect and physical prowess is off the charts. Which is why The Animal Liberation Alliance, a terrorist group, wants him. And they will take extreme measures to get him. However, Charlie is determined to fight back for the sake of his loved ones.

metas.name: ANIMAL LOVE
metas.description: In this fictional drama, Kaia, a trap artist from the outskirts of the city, meets Nico, an upper-class young man with existential angst. Despite their different realities and the outside forces pushing them apart, they try to make space for their love to grow, and in doing so, unleash a gang war.

metas.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
metas.description: Showcases a retelling of the Arthurian legend set in a Roman-occupied Britain where barbarian invaders threaten to lay claim to the island.

metas.name: High School! Kimengumi
metas.description:
Rei Ichido, Go Reietsu, Kiyoshi Shusse, Jin Daima, and Dai Monohoshi are five mischievous boys attending Ichiou Junior High. Each with an eccentric personality and a knack for chaos, they've earned a reputation as the infamous "Kimen-gumi."

One day, new transfer student Yui Kawa and her friend Chie Uru encounter the group and soon find themselves drawn into their antics. Around them are other colorful cliques—from the handsome "Iro Otoko-gumi" led by Shou Kireide, to the delinquent "Ban-gumi" led by You Nihiruda, the athletic "Ude-gumi" led by Kai Undou, and the tough girl squad "Onna-gumi" led by Jako Amano.

As time passes and a new spring begins, the everyday lives of these eccentric students unfold in a lively and comedic school story.

metas.name: Ride or Die
metas.description: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

metas.name: Campus Drivers
metas.description: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

metas.name: Scarpetta
metas.description: A brilliant forensic pathologist uses forensic technology to solve crimes.

metas.name: If I Never Loved You
metas.description: Elena sacrifices her heart for a 30 billion investment, saving Nolan's bankrupt family and his life and then breaking up with him. Seven years later her artificial heart is failing and their daughter requires lung surgery.

metas.name: Alliance
metas.description: A competitive captive reality show blending high-stakes strategy, economy and psychological warfare. Sixteen celebrities are split into four teams, battling through physical and mental challenges to earn points-the only currency inside a mysterious HQ run by the System. Face the Ace's power, survive weekly votes, and rebuild alliances every reset.

metas.name: Partick Thistle: One Team in Glasgow
metas.description: In Glasgow, football isn't just a game—it's a religion. And for 150 years, one small club has offered sanctuary to those seeking an alternative faith. After seven years in Scotland's second tier, the 2024/25 season promised to be different for Partick Thistle. With a boosted budget and renewed ambition, Thistle were finally favourites to win promotion back to the Premiership. The club opened their doors to a film crew expecting to document a long-awaited title triumph. Through unprecedented access to players, management, and the fans and volunteers who are the club's lifeblood, this series explores the beautiful futility of supporting the underdog.

metas.name: Daldal
metas.description: Haunted by the guilt of her past and dealing with the demons of her present, a newly-appointed DCP, Rita Ferreira, must embark on an investigation of a series of murders that puts her on a collision course with a cold-blooded serial killer.

metas.name: Code 13
metas.description: Queen Modjadji is a South African television period drama series inspired by the Balobedu rainmaker, the first Queen Modjadji, whose bloodline has ruled Southern Africa's Lobedu clan for centuries.

metas.name: The Price of Milk
metas.description: Behind the iconic '90s "Got Milk?" ads lies a complex battle, as this deep dive explores America's complicated relationship with milk, from dairy farms to Washington politics.

metas.name: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
metas.description: Stripping things back to what really matters. Bear helps people resolve deep personal rifts in the Welsh wilderness, combating conflict with the raw, revealing power of nature.

metas.name: Isakapatnam
metas.description: In 1990s Isakapatnam, a brutal port town's most powerful man faces three threats: a woman seeking justice, a conflicted henchman, and a vengeful common man all determined to dismantle his empire.

metas.name: Pass the Salt
metas.description: A sheltered Muslim-Iranian grad student falls in love with a young Jewish woman and must navigate coming out to her overbearing traditional Muslim family.

metas.name: The Grand Tour
metas.description: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

metas.name: A Love Other Than Yours
metas.description: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

metas.name: The Grand-ish Tour
metas.description: Gathering in the care home where they now live, Jeremy Clarkson, Richard Hammond and James May host three special shows looking back at their favourite Grand Tour moments. Or at least the ones they can remember. Their fading memories stretch from California to Mongolia to Italy and everywhere in between, and include classic moments of misery featuring mud, water, and at least two actual injuries.

metas.name: No Signal
metas.description: Eight influencers accustomed to showcasing an idyllic life on social media attend a transformative retreat to get to know themselves better. What lies behind the perfect life they project?

metas.name: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
metas.description: In the year 2029, Niihama City has become a technologically advanced metropolis. Due to great improvements in cybernetics, its citizens are able to replace their limbs with robotic parts.

metas.name: The Silent Noise
metas.description: In the coastal town of Escondido, Eli, a deaf, 10-year-old child, struggles to make sense of the sudden death of his beloved teacher, Sam Ignacio. As police investigate further, suspicion falls on his family. While they search for the truth, Eli watches his home crumble as devastating secrets unravel.

metas.name: Mission: Help My Home with Julianna Claire
metas.description: Julianna tackles common problems in many homes. From smart storage to shelving, she'll offer tips, tricks, and a collection of Amazon products to organize on a budget!

metas.name: Welcome Home: Los Angeles
metas.description: Welcome Home is a compelling 12-episode crime documentary series that intricately weaves the stories of formerly incarcerated men and women, exploring their journeys from crime to redemption.

metas.name: Marked
metas.description: MARKED is an emotional tattoo competition series where powerful real-life stories inspire two artists to create competing original tattoo designs, with the chosen design becoming a permanent work of art.

metas.name: Banner Dogs: The Aleph Journey
metas.description: "Banner Dogs: The Aleph Journey" tells the 20-year path that took Aleph from a $5,000 beginning to a global leader worth over $2B. It recounts the journey of Gastón Taratuta and the team who turned a Latin American vision into a multicultural network across 130+ markets, showing how resilience and diversity turn uncertainty into opportunity.

metas.name: L.A.U.G.H. (Life Ain't Usually Great Here)
metas.description: Follows a group of friends navigating life's challenges in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Murder 101
metas.description: Part teen drama, part masterclass, and part edge-of-your-seat crime investigation, follow a high school sociology class in rural Tennessee who help revive a decades-old case into a present-day hunt for a killer.

metas.name: Killing Grounds: The Gilgo Beach Murders
metas.description: When a woman vanishes, police find bodies along Long Island's shore. Years of dead ends and overlooked victims stall the case until a new task force spots a suspect hiding in plain sight. With trial looming, insiders and families speak.

metas.name: Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi
metas.description: Miya lives with her fearsome stepmother and her two daughters, and is resigned to a miserable life at their hands. However, they are actually kind and sweet to her, and a comedy of errors sets off.

metas.name: Yes or No Games
metas.description: 128 contestants battle it out in 24 breathtaking worlds for €100,000. From the jungle to a pirate island to outer space, Steven Gätjen asks one question: Yes or No? Each answer determines whether the contestant wins or is eliminated. Only the one who masters all worlds wins everything.

metas.name: Candy Caries
metas.description: Ame is a child who loves sweets. Living inside her mouth is a cavity named Caries! Caries calls Ame "Mom," turns teeth into furniture, and even hijacks her body. Ame is always being pushed around by this free-spirited cavity. "I'm not your Mom!" Ame cries. "Yes you are! You gave me a room and feed me sweets," retorts Caries. Enjoy this slapstick comedy about a slightly strange parent-child pair!

metas.name: El Mochaorejas
metas.description: The story of Daniel Arizmendi's rise, the corruption and fear that allowed his gang to terrorize Mexico in the 1990s, where he became known as "el mochaorejas" for his shady crimes

metas.name: Every Year After
metas.description: Two lifelong friends explore the enduring question: what if your first love was destined to be your soulmate? A sweeping romantic tale about love's timeless possibilities.

metas.name: The Trial
metas.description: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

metas.name: Cupertino
metas.description: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

metas.name: Final Table
metas.description: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

metas.name: La Broma Maestra
metas.description: Top Prank is a comedy show where the cast of Betty La Fea and 14 expert improv actors pull off television's most ambitious prank: a completely fake acting workshop designed to test the talent and resilience of an unknown actor who doesn't know he is the star of his own series. An unprecedented deception and a tribute to the actor's journey.

metas.name: Elle
metas.description: Follows Elle Woods' journey through high school, exploring the formative experiences that mold her into the iconic, confident "Legally Blonde" character.

metas.name: 56 Days
metas.description: When an unidentified body is found in a luxury apartment linked to Oliver Kennedy and his girlfriend Ciara Wyse, Detectives Lee Reardon and Karl Connolly reconstruct the couple's deadly romance across the past 56 days.

metas.name: KILL BLUE
metas.description: Legendary hitman Juzo Ogami has never failed an assignment. But after a mission, he’s stung by a mysterious wasp and wakes up in the body of a 13-year-old boy! And to make things even weirder, he receives a bizarre new order: infiltrate a middle school. Now the once-feared assassin must balance the chaos of school life with his deadly work, all while searching for a way to regain his adult body!

metas.name: Steal
metas.description: A typical day at Lochmill Capital is upended when armed thieves burst in and force Zara and her best friend Luke to execute their demands. In the aftermath, conflicted detective Rhys races against time to find out who stole £4 billion pounds of people's pensions and why.

metas.name: Day One
metas.description: Ulises Albet, a computer prodigy who leaves Barcelona after the suicide of his sister due to bullying. Ten years later, a call from his former partner brings him back to face his past and a global threat.

metas.name: Circo Gómez
metas.description: Filiberto Gómez (Derbez) must do whatever it takes to keep his circus afloat. With Lupe, Vicky, Refugio, Lobito, and Chiquimoco, this family of circus performers will do everything possible to ensure their circus survives.

metas.name: Local Times
metas.description: Four friends armed with blind ambition and street smarts fight to save a failing newspaper. It depicts their true strength lies in their friendship-especially when everything else falls apart.

metas.name: Schnick Schnack Pumuckl treibt Schabernack
metas.description: Pumuckl can no longer stand being alone in the workshop. Curious, the little kobold sets off on an adventure and, after an unintended boat ride on the Isar, ends up right in the middle of Munich. Starting from the English Garden, his turbulent journey back begins. Along the way, Pumuckl causes plenty of commotion, mischief, and unexpected encounters—playful, cheeky, yet always with heart and a strong sense of justice.

metas.name: Draw Your Weapons
metas.description: From Titmouse Animation Studios it's the show that flips the Actual Play format on its head with live drawing, real-time chaos, and confessional-style storytelling. Punk, DIY, and pure creative impulse fuel this high-energy love letter to doing things for the hell of it.

metas.name: Sweet as Sugar
metas.description: Olivia is an eccentric university student whose financial insecurity, curiosity and libido lead her to sugar babying. Life becomes stimulating as she interacts with her clients, students, roommate, crush, overbearing mom and nurturing Nan

metas.name: Days That Shocked the World
metas.description:
Days that Shocked the World explores the most iconic disasters of the last 50 years, combining eye-witness testimony with powerful archive footage, to learn how each tragedy changed both the lives of individuals and the world.

The anthology series features one- and two-part episodes that coincide with key anniversaries of these defining global events: including the Challenger Space Shuttle explosion in 1986, the Chernobyl nuclear disaster of the same year, the 2000 Air France Concorde crash, the 9/11 terrorist attacks in 2001 and the 2011 Fukushima earthquake and tsunami.

metas.name: LOL Next
metas.description: Spin-off of the hit series "LOL: Last One Laughing", hosted by Hazel Brugger.

metas.name: Mission to Space with Francis Bourgeois
metas.description: Trainspotter Francis chases a childhood dream to become an astronaut, plunging into a gruelling training regime in this heartfelt and surprising space odyssey.

metas.name: Ichijyoma Mankitsu Gurashi!
metas.description: Meiko Morita is chosen to transfer into an elite all-girls academy and moves to Tokyo to live in the student dormitory. To her surprise, the dorm also operates as a manga cafe - and she finds herself working there alongside the other residents. This is the beginning of Meiko's new life in a tiny one-tatami room!

metas.name: Maison Prison
metas.description: Yoko Ginbayashi is a celebrated chef whose fine Italian restaurant falls apart after the owner disappears with funds. Raising two children alone, she takes a job at a men's prison. While planning low-budget meals, she is called into the kitchen, where inexperienced inmates create chaos. Through her inventive cooking at Maison Prison, Yoko changes both the inmates and herself.

metas.name: Raakh
metas.description: Two teens disappear, devastating a tight-knit family and alarming the city. A determined officer launches a nationwide search, plunging into a dark realm of brutality and human evil.

metas.name: See You at Work Tomorrow!
metas.description: A weary office worker in a career slump ends up entangled with her cold, perfectionist boss, and through their clashes, the two unexpectedly become each other’s most important person.

metas.name: Authentic Escapes
metas.description: Hosted by travel expert Sandra McLemore, Authentic Escapes takes viewers beyond the typical tourist experience to discover the people, culture, traditions, and hidden gems that make each destination unique. From ancient landmarks and local cuisine to immersive cultural encounters and unforgettable adventures, each episode explores how authentic connections can transform a trip into a meaningful journey.

metas.name: World's Most Evil Women
metas.description: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

metas.name: NIPPON SANGOKU: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
metas.description: A revolution sparked by nuclear war, natural disaster, and misrule leads to the collapse of Japanese society. The country splits into three nations vying for hegemony, and the Sangoku era begins. Aoteru Misumi, a former agricultural officer, vows to reunify Japan. He rises through the ranks with only his knowledge and eloquence. Witness the legend of the man later hailed as a genius strategist.

metas.name: Siren's Kiss
metas.description: Cha Wooseok (Wi Hajun) receives a mysterious call from an informant who claims to have evidence of a fraud-related murder. Before revealing the truth, the informant falls to her death. Wooseok’s investigation leads him to Royal Auction and its chief auctioneer, Han Seol-ah (Park Minyoung), whose three fiancés have all died under suspicious circumstances. To expose the truth, or perhaps to test her, Wooseok proposes they fake a relationship. As he uncovers her secrets, he realizes he may have stepped into a web he can’t escape—and that getting out could cost him everything.

metas.name: The Greatest
metas.description: Chronicles Ali's life, career highs/lows, triumphs/struggles in/out of ring. Explores his personal relationships as father, husband, brother, son, behind public persona. Depicts defining moments that shaped boxing legend's iconic status.

metas.name: The Loyalty Game
metas.description: A group of women runs a unique business: luring men to expose their infidelity. Their newest client, Ana, lives a seemingly perfect life with her devoted husband-until doubt creeps in. As he starts to distort her reality, Ana teams up with a loyalty tester, and their search for truth spirals into a dangerous game of secrets, manipulation, and power-where loyalty becomes a matter of life and death.

metas.name: Fatal Fraud
metas.description: Delving into cases where financial schemes spiral into betrayal, violence and murder, exposing the deadly cost of lies fueled by greed.

metas.name: Siendo Marta Diaz
metas.description: A few days before her 25th birthday, Marta Díaz reveals who she was, is, and will be. With the support of family and friends, and many unpublished confessions, the content creator confronts the traumas, challenges, and decisions that will shape her new self. Marta will discover that growing older isn't the end of the world... but the beginning of her own life.

metas.name: Convenience Store Kyodai
metas.description: At a lively Mojiko convenience store, a charming manager and his mysterious brother turn everyday chaos into comedy, while a sharp-witted employee turns their antics into a viral webcomic.

metas.name: Sofia the First: Royal Magic
metas.description: Follow Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she discovers she is the most magical princess in the realm and must learn how to master her powers while making new royal friends.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Coven Academy
metas.description: Peer inside the halls of Coven Academy and discover the supernatural secrets that unfold in the lives of its students.

metas.name: Perfect Crown
metas.description: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Camp Rock
metas.description: ‪Glimpse the drama unfolding across Camp Rock.‬

metas.name: Magicampers
metas.description: Set at a day camp where the magical creatures Darly and Loomis, who are half-pig and half-Pegasus, and half-donkey and half-unicorn, enjoy every day adventure to explore what it means to grow up and discover yourself.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Descendants
metas.description: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Auradon Prep and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

metas.name: Disney Animation's Songs in Sign Language
metas.description: Follows three Disney animated songs reimagined in American Sign Language from Frozen 2, Encanto, and Moana 2, with a behind-the-scenes look at the collaboration.

metas.name: My Name Is Gutierrez
metas.description: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

metas.name: Cartoonified! With Kiff
metas.description: In Cartoonified, your favorite celebrities become cartoons in each new episode!

metas.name: Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi
metas.description: Kara and her ragtag Jedi crew seek out to find worthy Jedi to fight against an increasingly powerful warlord.

metas.name: The One Shot
metas.description: Eight of Japan's top comedians selected by Daigo, including M-1 finalists and King of Conte champions, must each write and direct a short film with just one rule: include a single, hilarious gag. In this unprecedented competition, skilled comedians have just "one shot" to prove their true talent.

metas.name: King & Prince: Our Meet-Up in LA
metas.description: Ren Nagase and Kaito Takahashi of King & Prince have always been by each other's side. In Los Angeles, they celebrate their bond with a uniquely themed adventure. The once inseparable pair must now part ways to complete a series of challenges before finding their way back to each other. This is the real Ren and Kaito, off-duty and offstage. Join them on their heartfelt journey across the United States and experience the simple joy of finally meeting up again.

metas.name: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
metas.description: Historians Dan Snow and Professor Suzannah Lipscomb investigate the lives and deaths of some of Tudor England's most fascinating figures, including Anne Boleyn, Mary, Queen of Scots, and Perkin Warbeck, who claimed to be one of the famed Princes in the Tower.

metas.name: Life in the W
metas.description: Life in the W, the ESPN Original Series, follows the 2025 WNBA season through the eyes of Las Vegas Aces' A'ja Wilson, Minnesota Lynx's Napheesa Collier, and Phoenix Mercury's DeWanna Bonner as they juggle basketball, love, family, and negotiations surrounding a new Collective Bargaining Agreement.

metas.name: Megan and Cupcake Ready for Preschool
metas.description: Follows Megan and her puppet sidekick Cupcake in the WOW Workshop as they lead kids on playful, hands-on adventures designed to help them feel confident, curious and ready to take on preschool.

metas.name: We Call It Imagineering
metas.description: Come along as we take you on an inside look at Walt Disney Imagineering. Inspired by how Walt took us along during the development of Disneyland, this series brings you into the creative and design journey as we turbocharge our Disney Experiences as Disney Imagineers create these new innovative experiences for the next decade and beyond.

metas.name: Battle of Fates
metas.description: Is our fate predetermined? And can anyone truly read it? A groundbreaking competition dares to find out. Korea's top 49 top Fate Readers—masters of shamanism, saju, tarot, and face reading—put their pride on the line. Only those who can genuinely read fate will survive. Who will be the winner?

metas.name: Dragon Striker
metas.description: Follows Key, a twelve-year-old farm boy who discovers he may be the legendary "Dragon Striker", and joins a team of underdogs to take on the school champions, while fighting to prevent an ancient evil from resurfacing.

metas.name: Dancing with the Stars: The Next Pro
metas.description: 12 exceptional up-and-coming dancers move into one house and compete in a grueling audition process, all vying for a coveted spot as a pro dancer on Season 35 of "Dancing with the Stars."

metas.name: CoComelon Playdates with Sanrio Friends
metas.description: It's time for the beloved characters of CoComelon and Sanrio to become friends in this fun world.

metas.name: Murder Club: Liar's Table
metas.description: A competitive mystery-variety series fusing deduction, role-play, and entertainment. Each episode drops the cast into a murder case as characters who gather clues, hold secret talks, and complete the story themselves—from the opening crime through character intros, clue rounds, interviews, a final vote, and the ending.

metas.name: Abandoned
metas.description: In 1984, three children were abandoned at a Barcelona train station with no memory of their identity or past. Unclaimed, they were adopted into loving homes. As adults, they now search for their biological parents.

metas.name: VisionQuest
metas.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

metas.name: Hey A.J.!
metas.description: Hey A.J.! is a high-energy journey with a curious, driven and extremely imaginative young lady. Telling her tale will call for fast-paced escapades, memorable songs and “transplendent” storytelling! AJ includes her family and friends in all her fantastical adventures. In collaboration with a Super Bowl Champion/Children's author, the SGS team brings this adventurous children's book series to television.

metas.name: Unexpected Loves
metas.description: What do a thief, a tennis coach, a nurse, and a tollbooth worker all have in common? Coming from unique plots and a variety of characters, in each episode Martín Bossi plays a different protagonist, someone in search of an unexpected love story.

metas.name: O11CE: Nueva generación
metas.description: Three former players return to their old academy to find their beloved Golden Hawks team struggling and facing relegation. They must revive the institute's glory and team spirit in this new soccer-filled chapter.

metas.name: Minimum Security
metas.description: Corinne runs Chénoise prison with her unlikely team: By-the-book Jeff, JP who's always been closer to inmates than colleagues, and rookie Stéphanie.

metas.name: Donna Hay Coastal Celebrations
metas.description: Best-selling Australian cookbook author, Donna Hay hosts a series of sunny celebrations by the sea, where she styles and cooks delicious food in beautiful locations. With Sydney’s harbour as the backdrop, Donna uses fresh produce to create simple and stunning food.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Zombies
metas.description: Glimpse the drama happening in the school hallways of Shadyside and Sunnyside and discover the secret adventures that unfold.

metas.name: Locker Diaries: Phineas And Ferb
metas.description: Class is back in session for Phineas And Ferb! But that doesn't mean the fun has to end. From inside school lockers, we follow the stepbrothers on new adventures.

metas.name: Disney Sidekick Adventures
metas.description: Disney's beloved sidekicks embark on mini adventures across their magical universe. Ever wondered about their perspective when they're on their own? Get ready for a whirlwind of fun as hijinks ensue.

metas.name: Soy Luna: Let's Roll Again
metas.description: After an accident that sidelined her, Luna returns to her beloved Jam & Roller. Putting on her skates again won't be easy, especially when a hidden villain's plan starts to complicate her life. She'll also face a dilemma, torn between old flames. Amidst songs, adventures, and reunions with friends, Luna will have to overcome many obstacles to fulfill her dream.

metas.name: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
metas.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

metas.name: The Doomies
metas.description: Follows best friends Bobby and Romy who open up a gateway to another world by mistake, turning their coastal town into a hotspot for horrifying creatures of doom, and must battle with both literal and inner monsters.

metas.name: Gold Land
metas.description: A woman from a small town discovers smuggled gold bars and must flee dangerous criminals, forcing her to head back to the place she swore to avoid.

metas.name: Agent P Under C
metas.description: Perry the Platypus battles an evil animal agent working for ANATHEMA (the Alliance of Nefarious Animals That Has an Exceptionally Memorable Acronym).

metas.name: Wonder Man
metas.description: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

metas.name: SABAN
metas.description: The story of Nick Saban's remarkable career, highlighted by his 17 seasons at Alabama, where he led the Crimson Tide to six national championships and reestablished the program as the preeminent force in college football.

metas.name: Jeff & His Super Hero Friends
metas.description: Join Jeff the Land Shark as he teams-up with the Avengers and Spider-Man in chaotic adventures against villains. Featuring characters like Hulk, Iron Man, Venom, and more.

metas.name: Food Samouraï
metas.description: Michelin-starred chef Mory Sacko travels to Japan to learn from culinary masters, master five traditional elements and create the perfect bento, embarking on a journey of discovery, discipline and Japanese gastronomy.

metas.name: If It's Tuesday, It's Murder
metas.description: A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

metas.name: Travis Japan Summer Vacation!! in the USA
metas.description: Travis Japan embarks on a summer road trip through the Rocky Mountains in North America. Divided into teams, one hits the road by RV, the other dives into local culture. With new horizons to explore and heartfelt connections to make, this road trip promises to be unlike any other.

metas.name: Best of the World with Antoni Porowski
metas.description: Follows Antoni Porowski as he travels through Paris, Mexico City, London and New York City to find places to eat, stay and enjoy while learning at inventive restaurants and exploring local culture.

metas.name: Love in Sync
metas.description: An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other's emotions.

metas.name: Friends Like These: The Murder of Skylar Neese
metas.description: Follows the investigation into the 2012 murder of West Virginia teen Skylar Neese, whose closest friends were implicated in her death, examining friendship and betrayal in the digital age.

metas.name: Chiraiya
metas.description: Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

metas.name: Apsara
metas.description: Braving modern-day evils, power-blessed Sunheri is the sole protector of her celestial clan! But her blood sister Dhara stands in her way! Can she fight her?

metas.name: Squatters: Get the F*** Out of My House
metas.description: Experienced squatters are exploiting legal loopholes to live rent-free.

metas.name: Big Girls Wanted: Escaping Pearadise
metas.description: Explores the rise of the Pearadise community and the complex, and at times conflicting, accounts from women connected to it.

metas.name: Surviving Alaska: Women of the Wild
metas.description: Across the vast wilderness of Alaska, four unique women share one goal: to thrive in the harsh and unpredictable conditions of the frozen winter landscape.

metas.name: The Scream Murder: A True Teen Horror Story
metas.description: When high school student Cassie Stoddart was found stabbed to death in a house on the outskirts of Pocatello, Idaho, the community was gripped by fear that a random killer was on the loose.

metas.name: Phony
metas.description: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

metas.name: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
metas.description: Inspired by his late mentor, Will Smith spends 100 days facing extreme challenges, venturing from pole to pole with scientists, explorers and experts.

metas.name: Mr & Mrs Office
metas.description: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: In the haunted heart of New Orleans, three teenage witches and their warlock peers attend an elite magic boarding school where power is currency, secrets are lethal and attraction is a liability.

metas.name: Girl on the Run: The Hunt for America's Most Wanted Woman
metas.description: Follows the story of Sarah Pender, convicted of double murder in 2000, who escaped from an Indiana maximum-security prison in 2008 and evaded capture for months as America's Most Wanted Woman.

metas.name: In Your Radiant Season
metas.description: An unpredictable, brilliant romance that awakens frozen time when a man named 'Chan', who lives every day like an exciting summer vacation, and a woman named 'Ran', who has locked herself in winter, meet as if by fate.

metas.name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
metas.description: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

metas.name: The Cult Behind the Killer: The Andrea Yates Story
metas.description: Follows the Andrea Yates case, exploring how a rogue street preacher's fire-and-brimstone teachings allegedly brought the vulnerable Texas mother under his control, leading to the drowning of her five children in 2001.

metas.name: Vienna Game
metas.description: While Napoleon Bonaparte is exiled on Elba, kings and crown princes, ministers and spies, noblewomen and mistresses, adventurers, inventors, artists, and concubines gather in Vienna to celebrate and negotiate. Here, the fate of Europe is decided on the dance floor and in the boudoir.

metas.name: Bear Grylls is Running Wild
metas.description: Bear Grylls takes some of today's biggest stars on a 48-hour journey through breathtaking and often unforgiving wilderness. From Norway’s glacial terrain to Wales’ Eryri mountains, each adventure pushes guests to their limits with glacier crossings, canyon descents, desert treks, and even a freefall from 11,000 feet. Along the way, thrilling action and revealing conversations uncover a side of these celebrities rarely seen.

metas.name: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
metas.description: In the face of death, plague, or pestilence, how did our ancestors respond? Though we may assume superstition and quack medicine were the only options available, the truth is far more interesting...Modern archaeology unearths long-buried traditions, arcane modes of healing, and medical enigmas. From astrology and omens to ointments, sweat baths, and bloodletting, ancient treatments were dispensed with at-times surprising results. Toxic antidotes and pirate medical chests, treatises on ancient acupuncture, and medical prescriptions etched into stone...relics reveal a stunning world of ancient healing practices. During times of war and plague, patients rely on the careful hands of barber-surgeons who perform rudimentary surgeries. In the ruins of a Roman army hospital, traces of an empire intent on medical innovation come to light. From abracadabra to Ayurveda ancient amputations, and toxic tinctures...unearthing ancient medical knowledge sheds light on how humans once sought to stay alive.

metas.name: Kappi Squad
metas.description: Four young friends embark on a journey to start a café together.

metas.name: Azhagae Azhagu
metas.description: In a strict patriarchal home, Azhagu Malar and Mathi arrive. Their contrasting natures challenge male dominance and bring unexpected change.

metas.name: That Thrifting Show
metas.description: Two design teams race to transform identical rooms using vintage and thrift finds. Expert Spencer guides them as they create stylish spaces on tight time and budget constraints.

metas.name: Rabbit Hole
metas.description: A 10-part variety show featuring popular digital creators competing in collaborations, challenges, games and performances.

metas.name: Vikram On Duty
metas.description: Battling his past and personal demons, a disgraced but brilliant supercop will stop at nothing to solve crimes and earn back the uniform that defined him.

metas.name: Swipe Right on the Devil
metas.description: Revisits the 2017 murder of 24-year-old Sydney Loofe, who disappeared and was later found dead after going on a Tinder date with Bailey Boswell.

metas.name: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
metas.description: Brave voyagers cross millions of miles of harsh Pacific Ocean in handmade canoes. Becoming master navigators, they find thousands of islands, overcome deadly natural barriers, and build an ocean world like no other.

metas.name: Neighborhood Watch
metas.description: Each episode shows wild footage from home cameras across America - security cams, doorbells, nanny cams and baby monitors catch neighbors, workers and unexpected visitors doing bizarre things.

metas.name: House of Stassi
metas.description: Stassi Schroeder is stepping back into the spotlight to redefine her place in pop culture — but staying on top means confronting the ghosts of her past and a chaotic inner circle with a talent for disrupting her life.

metas.name: Evil Lives Here: My Child the Killer
metas.description: Follows parents confronting the unthinkable truth that their child has grown into a monster who committed horrifying crimes, featuring first-person interviews.

metas.name: Pompeii: Out of Time with Tom Hiddleston
metas.description: A historical exploration about the eruption of Vesuvius in 79 A.D. and the preserved Roman city it left behind.

metas.name: Love Overboard
metas.description: Singles board a lavish yacht seeking romance, but accessing its luxuries comes with challenges. As they navigate love and betrayal on the high seas, only one pair will emerge victorious.

metas.name: Alice and Steve
metas.description: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

metas.name: The Well
metas.description: Before an aging serial killer on death row takes his secrets to the grave, a team of detectives in California's rural Central Valley are thrust back into the decades-old "Speed Freak Killers" mystery. Guided by one of the killers himself, the female-led team hunts for undiscovered victims and seeks atonement for their department's past mistakes.

metas.name: Brothers and Sisters
metas.description: Bound by love and unspoken truths, Shanmuga Sundaram and his devoted family's lives revolve around shared rituals... till hidden cracks begin to surface.

metas.name: Sayoneee
metas.description: For young Saanvi, the word mother equals world. When fate brings her close to her long-lost mother, a promise stands between their reunion! But for how long?

metas.name: Celebrity Crime Scene
metas.description: A revolutionary virtual recreation rebuilds Marilyn Monroe's death scene with unprecedented precision, allowing crime scene investigators to step back into 1962 and reexamine the evidence.

metas.name: Hidden Beneath the Cities
metas.description: Uncovers the extraordinary worlds lying just below modern urban centers. Beneath the streets of stone, soil and concrete exist hidden realms shaped by survival, ritual and imagination. Uncovers the extraordinary worlds that exist beneath major urban centers, from the tombs and wartime shelters of Naples to the manmade Royston Cave in Hertfordshire, England.

metas.name: Pathrakhin
metas.description: Follows two sisters, Bhagyashree and Prajakta, who support each other through every challenge as their bond is tested by circumstances, society, and destiny.

metas.name: Yeh Fitoor Tera
metas.description: Saumya, a reclusive young woman burdened by traumatic past fears, lives a quiet life shielded from the world. Everything changes when she meets Jeet, a bold, free-spirited rebel who enters her life with fierce intensity.

metas.name: Somebody Knows Something
metas.description: Former law enforcement officer Kara Chamberlain investigates unsolved murders and missing persons cases, working with victims' families, police and online communities to generate new leads.

metas.name: Designed to Last
metas.description: The show brings together architects, engineers, and inventors to tackle one of today's most urgent challenges: safeguarding homes against unpredictable and extreme real-world conditions.

metas.name: Yacht Deals Monaco
metas.description: Follows would-be ship sellers competing to land a job with a top yacht broker on the Côte d'Azur.

metas.name: Mr. and Mrs. Parshuram
metas.description: Shivprasad and Shalini juggle middle-class family life with their two kids. But hush. Shivprasad is also a secret agent, how long can he keep up his cover?

metas.name: O Humnava Tum Dena Saath Mera
metas.description: Aparajita is an artist with a bitter past, and our hero Rakshit—a reserved businessman with no place for love! These two hearts meet, but will romance bloom?

metas.name: One Day in My Body
metas.description: Showcases people who live with some of the world's rarest medical conditions.

metas.name: Hunt for the Missing: Chicago
metas.description: In the series, retired Chicago Detective Pamela Childs revisits unsolved missing persons cases as she hopes to uncover new leads and find potential answers for the victims’ families.

metas.name: Not Suitable for Work
metas.description: Explores the next stage in young people's lives after college. Five work-obsessed twenty-somethings professionals living in Manhattan's Murray Hill neighborhood focused on achieving career success and find time for personal happiness.

metas.name: Furious
metas.description: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

metas.name: Suddenly Amish
metas.description: Follows six non-Amish individuals on a rare journey as they leave behind their modern "English" lifestyle and step into a deeply traditional Amish community in Lancaster, Pennsylvania.

metas.name: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
metas.description: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

metas.name: MEGASTORM
metas.description: Extreme weather events—including Hurricane Helene, the tornado outbreak in Tennessee, and the Australian bushfires—are examined in depth. Through accounts from survivors and witnesses, combined with adrenaline-fueled footage from the heart of the action, we explore how and why these events occurred, as well as the devastation they left in their wake.

metas.name: Get Huge: Looksmaxxing to Death
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of masculinity in the influencer age, where extreme biohacking, online performance and a series of suspicious deaths converge.

metas.name: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
metas.description: Born and raised behind bars, Sudar confronts the challenges of the outside world, all while striving to free her mother from prison.

metas.name: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
metas.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

metas.name: Lion
metas.description: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

metas.name: Cousins and Kalyanams
metas.description: A 26-year tale of six cousins in Kerala whose lives and relationships revolve around seven weddings.

metas.name: Million Dollar Nannies
metas.description: A young group of elite nannies heads to Ibiza to launch a new kind of agency, built by nannies, for nannies. They're promised VIP families, life-changing money, and a shot at something bigger than any of them could build alone. But fierce competition, personal drama, and a scandal from the past threaten to derail the dream before the summer sets.

metas.name: LBW: Love Beyond Wicket
metas.description: A former cricket star becomes a coach and leads struggling students who unite to preserve a legacy while finding their own paths.

metas.name: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
metas.description: A very scared man navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes, exploring fears that are both deeply personal and strikingly universal.

metas.name: True Tales of the Mob
metas.description: These are the real stories of life and death on the mean streets. True Tales of the Mob, hosted by musician, actor and mob aficionado Stevie Van Zandt, exposes the deadly power plays of organized crime in America.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: J.D. & Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time–medicine has changed, interns have changed, but their bromance has stood the test of time. Characters new and old navigate the waters of Sacred Heart with laughter, heart and some surprises along the way.

metas.name: Lingam
metas.description: A kabaddi champion is wrongly accused of a crime, forcing him into an underworld he never sought. His transformation into a notorious figure stems from fate's cruel hand, not personal choice.

metas.name: Secrets of the Bees
metas.description: Bertie Gregory follows bees, vital pollinators for a third of our food. Special cameras document one hive over three years, revealing 20,000+ bee species' hidden world, remarkable architecture, and intelligence.

metas.name: Betrayal: Secrets & Lies
metas.description: Explores lives undone by unthinkable betrayals and the courage it takes to survive scandalous confessions, secret lives, terrifying acts of violence, financial ruin and more, showing that when loyalty turns to lies, the truth does more than break hearts - it changes everything.

metas.name: Prince of Mollywood
metas.description: Firoz has one dream: become a Pan-Indian superstar. But everyone around him has other plans. His friends are experts at ruining things. Vappa Mammali turns producer hoping one flop will send him straight back to the family business. Umma is busy finding him a bride on matrimony sites. And then there's his girlfriend.

metas.name: History's Greatest Picks with Mike Wolfe
metas.description: Host Mike Wolfe discovers some of the most remarkable stories and financial values.

metas.name: Tod Kar Dil Mera
metas.description: Standing strong by his side, Raushni supports her husband Raj's dream of becoming an IAS officer. But a betrayal is about to shatter their blissful world!

metas.name: Wild Vacation Rentals
metas.description: Comedians and best friends D'Arcy Carden and Sherry Cola hit the road to discover the wildest vacation rentals across America.

metas.name: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
metas.description: Just as His Highness’s favored butterfly Reirin is beloved by the prince, jealous “court sewer rat” Keigetsu uses magic to swap their bodies—and their destinies.
