With a looming execution, Reirin embraces her new, healthy body, while Keigetsu learns Reirin’s life isn’t what it seems as she’s pulled into an inner-court conspiracy.

metas.name: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
metas.description: Eva Longoria explores French cuisine and culture.

metas.name: Maxxed Out
metas.description: Money troubles ripple through the lives of close-knit families and friends, testing bonds and forcing difficult choices as they navigate their changing relationships.

metas.name: Kara Swisher Wants to Live Forever
metas.description: Kara Swisher investigates the fast-growing world of longevity and anti-aging, cutting through the hype to separate real science from the wishful thinking. Fueled by the early death of her father and her own very serious health scare, she explores how far humans will go to extend their lives. Bringing decades of experience covering the technology industry, Swisher interrogates the belief among the world's wealthiest innovators that sheer ambition can finally outsmart mortality. In each episode, she draws on her deep connections in Silicon Valley and beyond, stepping in as both reporter and test subject to examine the unconventional emerging technologies shaping how long and how well we may live.

metas.name: Corregidora: The Darkest Night in Mexican Soccer
metas.description: Revisits the events of March 5, 2022, during the match between Querétaro and Atlas, reconstructing what unfolded and examining its aftermath, the conflicting narratives surrounding the case, and the questions that, four years later, remain unresolved.

metas.name: A Killer Story
metas.description: Investigative journalist Joe Sexton looks into a 2002 double homicide case in Kansas after receiving thousands of emails from Eileen Umbehr, a homemaker turned citizen sleuth. Eileen and her husband Keen are convinced that Dana Chandler, the woman accused of killing her ex-husband and his girlfriend, did not commit the crime and devote their lives to fighting for Chandler's innocence.

metas.name: Proud
metas.description: Follows Filip, a reckless young gay man who finds that an unexpected family tragedy shatters his reality.

metas.name: The Sex Slave
metas.description: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.

metas.name: Crown of Deceit: Inside the Miss Universe Scandal
metas.description: Follows former Miss USA and Miss Universe contestants, insiders and whistleblowers exposing misconduct rigging and NDAs behind the pageant, including a contestant walkout and judge resignation at the 2025 Miss Universe finals in Thailand.

metas.name: Big Bargain Holiday Showdown
metas.description: Follows teams of friends, family and neighbors competing to transform a room in their home into a holiday wonderland in 48 hours on a $500 budget, judged for a chance to win cash prizes.

metas.name: Born to Bowl
metas.description: Liev Schreiber narrates this documentary series that follows five competitors on the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA) Tour.

metas.name: Chopped Castaways
metas.description: Strands 12 elite chefs on a remote island, where survival skills are just as critical as culinary talent

metas.name: World's Bargain Dream Homes
metas.description: Follows buyers who seek beautiful, move-in ready homes in prime global locations at rock-bottom prices.

metas.name: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
metas.description: A reboot and spinoff of the classic Restaurant: Impossible. Hosted by chef Aarón Sánchez and restaurateur Jen Agg, the series focuses on rescuing struggling restaurants on the brink of failure using modern industry practices, a strict ticking clock, and a limited budget

metas.name: Poeta Caníbal
metas.description: Follows the case of José Luis Calva Zepeda, known as the Cannibal Poet; a shocking discovery leads to his arrest, unmasking how a charismatic, unsettling man transformed into a real-life monster.

metas.name: Ultras: Passion and Death
metas.description: Ultras: Passion and Death is an HBO docuseries that explores the violent and deeply rooted Spanish "ultras" football fan movement by examining three specific tragedies that forever altered the nation's sporting and cultural landscape. The series uncovers how the passion of fandom can escalate into extreme aggression and tribalism.

metas.name: Double Lives of Suburban Wives
metas.description: On the surface, they're wives, mothers, and suburban neighbors, but that's only half the story. Behind closed doors, these six St. Louis women secretly make a living creating spicy content.

metas.name: High Value Target: The Hunt for Saddam
metas.description: The first American to interrogate Saddam Hussein slowly starts to realize that the US invasion of Iraq is not as cut and dry, nor its outlook as positive, as Washington believes.

metas.name: Melania Rea
metas.description: On April 20, 2011, Melania Rea's body was found in a forest in Ripe di Civitella, in the Abruzzo National Park, near where she lived with her husband, army corporal major Salvatore Parolisi and 18-month-old daughter.

metas.name: GET JIRO
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

metas.name: The Howard Stern Show
metas.description: Each episode spotlights Howard Stern's boundary-pushing humor, social commentary, and intimate conversations – all with his iconic voice and unique perspective. Recognized as one of the best interviewers in the business, the series also features Howard's in-depth, candid conversations with celebrities, musicians, and more.

metas.name: Decades in Sports
metas.description: A landmark TV collaboration spanning decades of American history, culture, and cinema through multiple documentary series exploring each era from the 1960s through the 2010s.

metas.name: A Very Haunted Renovation
metas.description: Follows six designers living in Bihl Manor for 31 days while completing a renovation. They face elimination challenges testing their nerve and design skills as they transform the haunted mansion's spaces, pursuing a $50,000 cash prize.

metas.name: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab
metas.description: Follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based Cheathab House to confront trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds.

metas.name: Jeff Dunham's The Cars That Drove Us
metas.description: Cars began rolling off the assembly line over 100 years ago. Two billion vehicles later, we still can’t get enough. THE CARS THAT DROVE US takes viewers into Jeff Dunham’s garage — home to 130 legendary cars. Joined by his cast of characters, Dunham reveals the storied history of era-defining rides, from the Corvette Stingngray to the ill-fated Vector W8, as told by the engineers, artists, and socket slingers who built them.

metas.name: Kitchen Chaos
metas.description: Kitchen Chaos dives headfirst into the wild, unpredictable world of food with viral moments of jaw-dropping culinary triumphs and spectacular meltdowns. Think hibachi tricks gone wildly off the rails to bizarre and unhinged food recipes that must be seen to be believed.

metas.name: In the Eye of the Storm: Chasers
metas.description: Teams of expert storm chasers and certified weather spotters risk it all to venture into America's Tornado Alley. They self-shoot their encounters with nature at its most extreme, warn people in harm's way, and help save lives when disaster strikes.

metas.name: K-Everything: A CNN Original Series
metas.description: A cultural exploration of Korea’s explosive global influence, K‑Everything, hosted by Daniel Dae Kim, dives into how Korea’s music, film, food, and beauty industries reshaped global culture.

metas.name: The Good Spirit: Behind the Doors of the Opus Dei
metas.description: Fourteen men of all ages from eleven different countries recount their personal experiences within Opus Dei. Many of them held leadership positions while others were called to support the institution from the highest levels of their professional careers to expand Opus Dei. Some were sent as teenagers to countries from which they never returned.

metas.name: Conspiracies & Coverups
metas.description: Former CIA covert intelligence officer Andrew Bustamante exposes the truth behind some of the most sensational, "ripped from the headlines" conspiracy theories in the all-new series. Driven by a relentless hunt for the truth, Bustamante pulls back the curtain on modern-day mysteries that blur the line between fact and fiction. Using his unique perspective and insider techniques, he investigates, pressure-tests, and challenges prevailing narratives to reveal the hidden forces behind these events and the motives used to manipulate the truth.

metas.name: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos
metas.description: A three-part docuseries examining the life and crimes of notorious American serial killer Aileen Wuornos, who shot and killed seven male clients while working as a prostitute in Florida in 1989 and 1990. She was arrested in 1991 and spent around 10 years on death row before being executed in 2002.

metas.name: Portobello
metas.description: Tells the story of Enzo Tortora, the famous host of the television program "Portobello", accused by some collaborators of justice of being part of a Camorra organization dedicated to drug trafficking.

metas.name: The Man Will Burn
metas.description: Traces the evolution of Burning Man, from its anarchic countercultural roots in San Francisco to the 80,000-person desert gathering it has become.

metas.name: DTF St. Louis
metas.description: A love triangle among three adults experiencing middle-age malaise leads to one of them ending up dead.

metas.name: Lanterns
metas.description: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: Disaster: The Chernobyl Meltdown
metas.description: The Chernobyl disaster is the worst nuclear accident in history, releasing 400 times more radiation into the atmosphere than the Hiroshima bomb.

metas.name: Building Back America's Trades
metas.description: Chronicles the stories of students, mentors, and teachers as they remake the trades industry and themselves.

metas.name: Craig Ferguson: American on Purpose
metas.description: Craig Ferguson travel coast-to-coast to explore the defining ideas, and contradictions, at the heart of the United States. Guided by his distinct humor and point of view, Ferguson examines the country's founding ideals while reflecting on his own experience becoming an American citizen. Along the way, he visits iconic locations and unexpected corners of the country and encounters a wide range of voices from comedians and entrepreneurs to historians and everyday Americans.

metas.name: Food Network's Top 10
metas.description: With opinions everywhere about where to find the best bites, Food Network cuts through the noise with Food Network's Top 10 - a new series delivering definitive, crave-worthy rankings of the can't miss dishes across America. Award-winning chefs break down the bites that are truly worth the hype, the splurge, and even a road trip, with the rankings driven by firsthand experience, expertise, and passionate debate about what makes a truly great dish. Each episode counts down the Top 10 in a craveable category - from Brunch and BBQ to Burgers and Pizza - serving up expert insight, insider intel, saucy secrets, and plenty of hot takes along the way.

metas.name: Mel Brooks: The 99 Year Old Man!
metas.description: Directors Judd Apatow and Michael Bonfiglio explore the life and legacy of Mel Brooks, one of the most enduring comedic voices of our time.

metas.name: Gang War Oslo
metas.description: An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

metas.name: The Topurias
metas.description: Ilia Topuria is one of the biggest stars in MMA. This documentary explores his personal side and reveals a side of the champion never seen before.

metas.name: Most Extreme Humans
metas.description: Explores the lives of people with extraordinary physical conditions, rare medical challenges, and remarkable transformations as they navigate everyday life, relationships, and the pursuit of their dreams.

metas.name: Privileges
metas.description: Hoping for a last chance at redemption, a young inmate takes a job inside a luxury Parisian hotel rife with ruthless ambition and betrayal.

metas.name: Et monsters bekendelser
metas.description: Two journalists are drawn into investigating an international criminal conspiracy after an arms dealer reaches out to them, leading to a dangerous pursuit across borders.

metas.name: Roast My Rental
metas.description: Follows comedian Leslie Jones as she crashes America's worst short-term rentals and, with renovation expert Jasmine Roth, transforms them from one-star disasters into five-star vacation getaways in 72 hours.

metas.name: Collision
metas.description: When business magnate Miguel Ángel dies in a mysterious crash, his daughter Zoé and estranged wife Belén fight for control of his company.

metas.name: The Many Lives of Benjaman Kyle
metas.description: Follows two producers who try to help an amnesiac man found behind a Burger King to discover his identity, but uncover lies, three unsolved cold cases, and a connection to a crime family, placing themselves in danger.

metas.name: President Curtis
metas.description: President Andre Curtis and his eccentric staff deal with various crises that Rick Sanchez typically ignores.

metas.name: Bachelor Mansion Takeover
metas.description: In a high-stakes design competition, 12 Bachelor Nation alums return to renovate the iconic mansion. They must design, build and strategize their way to the top. Only one winner will walk away with a cash prize and the ultimate bragging rights.

metas.name: OJ Unseen: Exploitation of Evil
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage from O.J. Simpson's prank show reveals how a volatile comeback attempt unraveled. Mounting tension, uneasy encounters, and behind the scenes truths test the ethical boundaries of America's media machine.

metas.name: Youth
metas.description: A 50-year-old divorcee juggles dating life while taking care of her parents and adult son.

metas.name: Deep Revenge
metas.description:
The protagonist, Nozomi, was on the peak of happiness after conceiving a child with her husband, Ryoichi, but she was involved in an accident whilst on holiday.

When she next awoke, she was told that the baby she was carrying had been stillborn, and that four years had passed.

metas.name: This Land
metas.description: Explore how the United States expanded from a fragile experiment along the Atlantic coast into a nation spanning an entire continent, revealing extraordinary sacrifices and untold personal accounts that dramatically reframe the story.

metas.name: Tropic Like It's Hot
metas.description: Explores luxury real estate and lifestyle opportunities in tropical locations, targeting viewers interested in both upscale living and romantic possibilities.

metas.name: 120 Hours Behind Bars
metas.description: Over five intense days, 120 Hours Behind Bars delivers an unfiltered look inside America's toughest jails -- where officers are outnumbered, cellblocks are overcrowded, and violence erupts without warning.

metas.name: Murder in Glitterball City
metas.description: The city of Louisville, Kentucky, known for its historic Victorian architecture and birthplace of the mirrored glitterball, proves to be an unlikely backdrop for a dark tale of murder. This documentary explores the shifting landscape of a mysterious killing, a toxic relationship, a vulnerable victim and the unreliable accounts of two ex-lovers on trial for their lives.

metas.name: U.S. Against the World: Four Years with the Men's National Soccer Team
metas.description: A look inside the United States Men’s National Soccer Team in the leadup to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America in June. Filmed over the course of four years, the series follows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah, Weston McKennie, and an array of U.S. players on their personal and collective journeys toward their sport’s biggest stage.

metas.name: The Narco Hack
metas.description: An impenetrable encrypted messaging app becomes a safe haven for organised crime -- until French investigators hack their way in.

metas.name: Neighbors
metas.description: Examines stories of absurd, outrageous, and dramatic real-life residential conflicts from a wide range of larger-than-life characters across the United States, opening a verité portal into the lives of contemporary American.

metas.name: Home Town: Inn This Together
metas.description: Ben and Erin Napier work on their project to restore the Kress building, a dilapidated structure from 1930 located in downtown Laurel, Mississippi, alongside their family and friends Jim, Mallorie, and Josh.

metas.name: Flavortown Food Fight
metas.description: Long referred to but never before seen, the mythical and delicious Flavortown will be the setting for this multi-round, culinary competition. In each episode, Fieri will welcome three chefs to Flavortown where skills and cooking chops can earn advantages and ultimately a win. Competitors will choose their own adventure as they compete in authentic food establishments ranging from street food carts to neighborhood spots to fast casual eateries and the finest fine dining restaurants in the world. The chefs must be quick on their feet as their culinary knowledge, technical skills, and overall cooking acumen are tested round after round. With restaurant names inspired by Guy's life, the series will deliver everything fans have ever dreamed Flavortown could be. The winner of each episode has a chance to score up to $20,000 in prize money and will return to defend their title against two new chefs the following week.

metas.name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
metas.description: Comedy sketches exploring various historical moments, with four different sketches per episode.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

metas.name: Women's Hell
metas.description: Follow a woman's fight for justice for victims of sexual assault – and her own autonomy – in pre-WWII Poland.

metas.name: Maniacs of the Truth
metas.description: This two-part documentary series explores Hungary’s most notorious and high-profile criminal cases following the fall of communism through the regular dinner gatherings of a unique group of friends - including retired detective Ernő Tóth and his former colleagues.

metas.name: Game Day Murders
metas.description: Game Day Murders is a six-episode series about "shocking murder cases that rocked the world of sports and forever altered the lives of athletes, teammates, families, and entire communities

metas.name: The Serial Killer Connection
metas.description: The ex-wife and survivor of serial killer Richard "Marc" Evonitz unite to uncover his untold life and crimes and as they dig deeper, they confront the chilling possibility that the full scope of his crimes has yet to be revealed.

metas.name: Lost Women of Alaska
metas.description: The brutal murders of two Alaska Native women and the shocking investigation that led authorities to their sadistic killer

metas.name: Crashers
metas.description: Follows home restoration expert Jonathan Knight as he ambushes unsuspecting homeowners to offer free 72-hour renovations with three rules: starts immediately, no design input, and they must vacate.

metas.name: Cooking with Choi
metas.description: Esther Choi shares her favorite Korean and Korean American recipes, from her upstate New York home to yours.

metas.name: Bobby Flay’s The Line
metas.description: Chef Bobby Flay is pulling back the curtain on the high-stakes realities of working on a restaurant line. In the new competition series, we get to watch Bobby lead his hand-picked home team of extraordinary chefs — Antonia Lofaso, Michael Jenkins and Claudette Zepeda — against some of the country’s most acclaimed restaurant staffs. These dueling lines must execute a flawless dinner service for real diners in real time. If the visiting restaurant team prevails, they'll win $25,000.

metas.name: Property Brothers: Under Pressure
metas.description: The twins assist cautious homebuyers in making informed choices, helping them navigate homebuying ups and downs, then implement design solutions during renovations to achieve their ideal homes.

metas.name: Colosio: Political Assassination
metas.description: A docuseries examining one of Mexico's most controversial political events: the 1994 assassination of presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio. It explores the investigation, contradictions, and unanswered questions surrounding the case.

metas.name: Fit for a Killer
metas.description: This chilling docuseries chronicles one of Poland's most notorious cold cases -- the brutal 1999 murder of female student Katarzyna Zowada.

metas.name: The Dark Wizard
metas.description: An unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, the world's most influential and controversial climber, base jumper and highline walker, who achieves jaw-dropping feats while battling his inner demons.

metas.name: Half Man
metas.description: Ruben turns up at his estranged brother Niall's wedding, acting as a catalyst for a revival of the last 40 years of their relationship.

metas.name: Saman: La verità nascosta
metas.description: This is a three-part docuseries that reconstructs the tragic story of Saman Abbas, the 18-year-old Pakistani girl killed in Novellara in 2021.

metas.name: My Brother the Minotaur
metas.description: When a Minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure with help from his brother and friends, to understand who he really is.

metas.name: Unconditional
metas.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

metas.name: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
metas.description: Explores the history and the recent win by UConn Huskies Women's Basketball team of the 2025 NCAA National Championship, through a mix of archival footage and interviews.

metas.name: Cape Fear
metas.description: A happily married couple faces a growing threat when a notorious killer from their past, Max Cady, is released from prison and seeks revenge.

metas.name: Imperfect Women
metas.description: After a murder shatters the lives of three best friends, their decades-long bond is tested when an investigation reveals betrayals and shocking truths.

metas.name: Nocturne
metas.description: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

metas.name: Brothers
metas.description: Matthew and Woody have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

metas.name: Awkwafina: The Unlikely Cook
metas.description: Follows Awkwafina as she embarks on a deeply personal cross-country journey exploring contemporary Asian American cuisine, starting with her family's own legacy, despite growing up in the family business but being unable to cook at all.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: The magical and mundane unfold in a suburban shed as a lonely man stumbles on the supernatural.

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.
Three intertwined timelines follow the planning and execution of a daring heist in Zurich and its aftermath as an FBI agent pursues a master criminal across Europe.

metas.name: Margo's Got Money Troubles
metas.description: The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

metas.name: Twisted Yoga
metas.description: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they'd joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.

metas.name: Star City
metas.description: Soviet cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers risk everything in an ambitious space program aiming to be the first to reach the moon.

metas.name: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
metas.description: A divorced mom gets caught up in a perilous web of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

metas.name: Route 187
metas.description: Citizens combat urban violence until a bus driver and student's murders by thugs spark outrage, leading authorities to hunt the culprits captured on video.

metas.name: My Killer Father: The Green Hollow Murders
metas.description: Small-town rumors of a local serial killer become national news when a woman alleges her father killed dozens of women, including three of his wives, and forced her and her siblings to help bury bodies in an old well when they were children.

metas.name: Star Trek: Starfleet Academy
metas.description: Young cadets train to become Starfleet officers as they deal with friendships, rivalries, and romance, all while facing a mysterious threat to both the Academy and the Federation.

metas.name: Out of My Way! Reborn Mafia Queen Is Here
metas.description: Reborn after Felicia's past-life bullying-where her identity was stolen and it ultimately led to her death-Arya is determined to claim her rightful place as a mafia heiress. She sets out to outwit and humiliate Felicia at every opportunity

metas.name: Free Nelson Mandela
metas.description: The series documents Mandela’s journey from activist to revolutionary, from prisoner to negotiator and how he led South Africa to democracy from a prison cell. The image of Mandela walking free from prison after 27 years is one of the most iconic in history. It took a fierce political struggle and cultural battle to bring about his freedom, producing a global people-powered movement and an explosion of musical activism.

metas.name: Big John's Bosh! Family
metas.description: Fishers prep for Johnny's Monaco fight, Bosh Bingo and Big John's podcast.

metas.name: You Don't Know Where I'm From, Dawg
metas.description: A comprehensive look at the life and career of American soccer legend Clint Dempsey.

metas.name: Can You Keep a Secret?
metas.description: Debbie Fenton is a granny, lawn bowler, tinpot dictator - who will stop at nothing to make sure her family's protected. Unfortunately, most of the time the person they really need protecting from is her. When her hermit-like husband William unexpectedly dies, she makes an outlandish decision that will put the family under more pressure than ever before.

metas.name: Marshals
metas.description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves the Yellowstone ranch to work with an elite U.S. Marshals team.

metas.name: Team Moms: Baseball
metas.description: Follow a group of parents whose sons attend Legendary Prep Academy: a premier baseball training school in Scottsdale, Arizona, dedicated to molding the next generation of star athletes.

metas.name: Handsome Devil: Charming Killer
metas.description: A three-part docuseries that unravels how Wade Wilson — a 25-year-old Florida man arrested for the brutal murders of two women — unexpectedly became a social media fixation.

metas.name: The Madison
metas.description: A New York family's life unravels after a tragedy; they process their grief while vacationing in rural Montana, where they explore human connection amid their profound sorrow.

metas.name: America's Culinary Cup
metas.description: Top chefs compete in challenges testing creativity, endurance, presentation and leadership skills in America's Culinary Cup.

metas.name: Wild Boys: Strangers in Town
metas.description: In 2003, two young men emerge from the forests of British Columbia claiming to have been raised entirely off the grid. As a small town tries to help them, a mystery unfolds, testing how far people will go to believe the unbelievable.

metas.name: NCIS: New York
metas.description: Special Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to the NCIS field office and partners with a roguish agent, Nick Schaeffer, to help lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

metas.name: The Jigsaw Puzzle Murder
metas.description: When a dismembered torso is discovered in woodland on the edge of Salford, detectives launch a murder investigation with no DNA match, witnesses or obvious suspects. As a national media storm unfolds, forensic clues, new suspects and further discoveries across Greater Manchester begin to reveal the shocking truth behind the killing

metas.name: He Said, She Said: Till Death Do Us Part
metas.description: Follows a no-holds-barred custody battle between two high-powered lawyers, which extends beyond the courtroom into social media and the court of public opinion.

metas.name: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: A three-part docuseries, revealing the true story of Jordan Belfort and his boiler room brokers at Stratton Oakmont, which is even darker and more debauched than previously known.

metas.name: It Gets Worse
metas.description: Three best friends from college face eviction in London. As they scatter across the city, they navigate friendship, dating disasters, and adulting - all while the world crumbles around them.

metas.name: Made for March
metas.description: Follows the University of Michigan Wolverines and the University of Kansas Jayhawks basketball teams across the entire season as they bid for a national championship.

metas.name: Harlan Coben's Final Twist
metas.description: Known for his twisting narratives and intricate plots, Harlan Coben guides audiences through gripping tales of murder and high-profile crimes. Each story is meticulously unraveled to reveal hidden truths. With exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, each episode provides an in-depth look at stories where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: Canada Shore
metas.description: Ten young Canadians from across the country come together to share an unfiltered and unforgettable summer.

metas.name: Dutton Ranch
metas.description: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

metas.name: Girl Taken
metas.description: Follow the story of twin sisters Lily and Abby, whose lives are shattered when Lily is abducted from their quiet rural English town by beloved local teacher Rick Hansen. After years of abuse in captivity, Lily escapes - only to discover that freedom brings its own challenges.

metas.name: The Program: Texas Tech
metas.description: Follows the Texas Tech Red Raiders as Head Coach Joey McGuire builds a new team identity during a demanding offseason in the world of college football.

metas.name: Devotion: Obedience or Betrayal
metas.description: For over 50 years, daily life in Gloriavale has been governed by rigid beliefs and hierarchies as men rule over their wives. Shocking allegations of sexual abuse and a cover-up threaten their way of life.

metas.name: Among Us
metas.description: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.

metas.name: CIA
metas.description: Follows a partnership between a C.I.A Case Officer and an F.B.I. Special Agent who work together on a clandestine task force to prevent domestic terrorism in New York.

metas.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

metas.name: A Course Called Ireland
metas.description: Hollywood icon Bill Murray tours Ireland, blending golf with a quest to uncover his Irish ancestry.

metas.name: Eternally Yours
metas.description: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

metas.name: Golden Axe
metas.description: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

metas.name: Dalliance
metas.description: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

metas.name: Girls Need Love
metas.description: Following sorority sisters Tasia, Falynn, and Alexis as they navigate love, friendship, and ambition. The series focuses on their lives in the 404, exploring toxic dating, career pressures, and self-discovery amidst players and viral fame.

metas.name: Saturday Night Live UK
metas.description: British incarnation of NBC's legendary late-night comedy showcase. Broadcast live each week, this UK version brings the high-wire, anything-can-happen energy that makes 'SNL' a cultural force, now reimagined through a distinctly British lens.

metas.name: Still Flipping Out
metas.description: Follows Lewis as he navigates the hilariously unpredictable nature of his professional and personal lives as his trademark spontaneity collides with the people who work with him, for him, and still somehow survive him.

metas.name: Vanderpump Rules: Lisa Las Vegas
metas.description: Follow Lisa Vanderpump as she opens The Vanderpump Hotel (formerly The Cromwell) on the Las Vegas Strip in partnership with Caesars Entertainment

metas.name: The Miniature Wife
metas.description: Lindy and Les, a married writer and scientist, are forced to re-evaluate the power balances in their relationship after a freak accident shrinks Lindy down to 6 inches tall.

metas.name: M.I.A.
metas.description: Restless in the Florida Keys, Etta Tiger Jonze dreams of a life in Miami's glittering, sub-tropical kingdom. When her family's drug-running business shatters in tragedy, however, Etta embarks on a dangerous journey through Miami's neon-lit underbelly that will define who she is and what she's ultimately capable of.

metas.name: PONIES
metas.description: In 1977 Moscow, two "PONIES" ("persons of no interest") become CIA operatives and uncover a Cold War conspiracy their husbands were killed for.

metas.name: Field Generals: History of the Black Quarterback
metas.description: The stories of the trailblazing and pioneering quarterbacks who transformed American football—from the AFL-NFL merger through the turn of the century. By placing their journeys in full historical and social context, it reveals how politics, culture, and race shaped both their struggles and their triumphs.

metas.name: Catfish Murders
metas.description: The show investigates cases where victims are lured via fake romantic promises, false job offers, or online traps orchestrated by hidden perpetrators.

metas.name: OJ's Accomplice
metas.description: While the world was distracted by the media circus around O.J. Simpson's trial, they might have ignored a chilling possibility: he may have had help.

metas.name: Fan Level Midnight: Devoted to The Office
metas.description: Explore how the U.S. version of The Office grew from a ratings-challenged adaptation to one of the most enduring television series of its era. Traveling from the home of Dunder Mifflin in Scranton, Pennsylvania, to the soundstages in Van Nuys, California, the filmmakers also turn the camera toward the fans themselves.

metas.name: Ms. X
metas.description: A suburban mom and her high school friend plot to frighten her unfaithful husband straight, but their scheme spirals into murder, trapping her between law enforcement, drug lords, and ruthless PTA moms.

metas.name: Palisades & Eaton Fires: Devastation to Determination
metas.description: NBC4 Remembers the Palisades and Eaton fires one year later; from devastation to determination.

metas.name: A Beautiful Obsession
metas.description: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

metas.name: Line of Fire
metas.description: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

metas.name: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
metas.description: A disgraced former football player is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

metas.name: Newlyweds
metas.description: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

metas.name: Revealed Secrets
metas.description: A birthday celebration among a tight circle of Detroit friends cracks open years of hidden affairs and buried secrets, and the fallout eventually collides with a murder investigation that threatens to expose the truth for good.

metas.name: The 'Burbs
metas.description: A young couple moves back to the husband's childhood home, only to face threats from new neighbors and uncover dark secrets of their cul-de-sac.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of Rhode Island
metas.description: A tight-knit circle of Rhode Islanders who have deep community roots and families that go back generations.

metas.name: The Good Daughter
metas.description: Sisters Samantha and Charlotte Quinn have spent the last 28 years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence.

metas.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
metas.description: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

metas.name: Seeking Persephone
metas.description: To save her family, Persephone marries a cold, distant duke - never expecting to awaken a love that could change them both forever.

metas.name: The Claudia Winkleman Show
metas.description: A prime-time talk show that welcomes the biggest names from film, television, music and beyond for lively conversation with a studio audience.

metas.name: The Great American Journey
metas.description: Travels nationwide celebrating American history, exploring the people, places, and ideas that shaped our nation, examining how the American story evolves and each generation's role in defining the future.

metas.name: Surviving Earth
metas.description: Meet the bizarre, amazing and breathtaking creatures and landscapes of a vibrant lost world; and discover how life not only survived during the cataclysmic events of this prehistoric era, but thrived.

metas.name: The Killer Among Us
metas.description: A small community is devastated by murder. The killer isn't an outsider - they're one of their own. As suspicion spreads through town, trust erodes. Cumming explores close-knit places where the unthinkable occurs and everyone's a suspect.

metas.name: The Valley: Persian Style
metas.description: Reza Farahan, Golnesa “GG” Gharachedaghi and Mercedes “MJ” Javid share an unbreakable bond — one built on years of friendship, fiery clashes and the kind of history that never fades. They also share a deep connection to their Persian culture, something that runs just as strong in the group of friends they now call family. As they take on the next stage of life in the Valley, their world is bigger, their circle is bolder and their challenges are more real than ever. As we’ll see, their next chapter in life isn’t quieter, it’s just more complicated.

metas.name: Lobo, morir matando
metas.description: Lobo Rosales, a former detective, becomes a guardian to the daughter of a woman he once loved. He must flee with young Renata when he discovers that she holds the key to a hidden fortune that many criminals are willing to kill to find.

metas.name: The Wolves of Real Estate: The Alexander Brothers
metas.description: Investigates how three successful brothers ascended in the elite world of luxury real estate and private security in Miami and New York, all while harboring an extremely dark secret.

metas.name: Juego de Villanos
metas.description: Follows notorious reality TV personalities living under one roof as they navigate shifting alliances and compete in challenges to claim the title of ultimate Supervillain.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Single mother Pam Voorhees has been unable to shake her grief after her young, sickly son Jason tragically drowned in the town lake almost a year before. When two strangers arrive at Pam's door digging into her past, a disturbing chain of events is set into motion, leaving the townspeople of Crystal Lake wondering: just who is Pam Voorhees?

metas.name: The Five Star Weekend
metas.description: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

metas.name: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
metas.description: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win charts how Berlusconi turned A.C. Milan into a powerhouse and used its success to fuel his political rise, tracing his path from real estate and TV to football glory and ultimately Italy's top office.

metas.name: Mickey & Minnie's Holiday Songs: Halloween
metas.description: These sing-along, stop-motion music videos feature Mickey, Minnie and the gang as they get into the Halloween mood, dancing all around Hot Dog Hills and singing their way back home to the Clubhouse.

metas.name: Traveling with Snow Man
metas.description: Follow the popular J-Pop group Snow Man as they journey north from Okinawa to Hokkaido, showcasing the members’ adventures as they meet locals, savor regional cuisine, and explore the sights together. Joining them on this adventure is Tabi, an AI-style robot who acts as the group's 10th member – capturing their candid moments throughout the show.

metas.name: Imagineer That!
metas.description: Imagineer That! is back! Follow Tom Morrow 2.0, a zany mini-animatronic with insider access to Walt Disney Imagineering, as he answers your biggest questions and reveals the magic behind Disney attractions.

metas.name: Daughter of Fire
metas.description: A foreign woman returns to her hometown with another identity. Her presence raises suspicions, but no one imagines the truth: she is the key piece of a bloody revenge. Having everyone's trust, she puts her plan into action and commits the most brutal crimes in a town that hides more secrets than it seems.

metas.name: Cartoonified with Phineas and Ferb
metas.description: Your favorite celebrities become cartoons in each new episode. In this season of Cartoonified, Phineas and Ferb go on wild adventures with their favorite animated celebrities.

metas.name: The Manipulated
metas.description: Taejoong's life is torn apart when he's framed for a heinous crime and imprisoned. Discovering it was all orchestrated by someone on the outside, he embarks on a rage-fueled quest for revenge.

metas.name: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
metas.description: Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.

metas.name: Armorsaurs
metas.description: Armored dinosaurs and their skilled pilots defend Earth against hostile alien forces threatening global destruction.

metas.name: RoboGobo
metas.description: Five adorable adopted pets are given super-powered Robo-Suits by kid inventor Dax, then going on a mission to save other pets in trouble and learning how to become a family in the process.

metas.name: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
metas.description: Amanda Knox arrives in Italy for her study abroad only to be wrongfully imprisoned for murder weeks later. Follow Knox's relentless fight to prove her innocence and reclaim her freedom and examines why authorities and the world stood so firmly in judgment.

metas.name: The Murky Stream
metas.description: The fates of a man with a hidden past, a wise and just woman, and an upright man intertwine.

metas.name: BeddyByes
metas.description: MeMo and BaBa, best friends, journey across Planet BeddyByes, encountering various characters during their calming adventure toward sleep.

metas.name: Win or Lose
metas.description: As a championship game looms, eight characters are thrown a curveball in their off-the-field lives.

metas.name: Top Guns: The Next Generation
metas.description: Follow a class of Navy and Marine Corps student pilots as they enter the final and most unforgiving phase of elite strike fighter training. It's six months of high-stakes aerial training, brutal physical demands, and emotional reckoning - where only the top performers earn the chance to fly the most coveted aircrafts.

metas.name: Nine Puzzles
metas.description: Ten years after discovering her murdered uncle, Ena and Detective Hansaem must cooperate to stop a series of similar murders - each linked by strange puzzle pieces.

metas.name: Secrets of Ancient Structures
metas.description: Across the globe and throughout history, ancient civilizations erected structures that continue to inspire awe and wonder. But how did they do it? Archaeological finds and new technologies reveal clues to long-enduring mysteries.

metas.name: Ironheart
metas.description: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

metas.name: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
metas.description: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

metas.name: 20.000 leguas de viaje submarino
metas.description: Diego, his friends and Admiral Nemo try to save the ocean while facing great dangers.

metas.name: Low Life
metas.description: A dangerous story of rough people obsessed with shameless greed who gather together with their own greed and logic to find underwater artifacts off the coast of Shinan.

metas.name: Call My Agent Berlin
metas.description: A young woman moves to Berlin and unexpectedly lands a job as an assistant at a struggling talent agency.

metas.name: StuGo: Shorts
metas.description: The kids record vlogs for their families talking about their summer experiences on Dr. Lullah's island. The kids report home from Summer Camp.

metas.name: I AM BOXER
metas.description: Don Lee's extreme boxing survival. Who will survive to be the champion standing in the ring?

metas.name: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
metas.description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

metas.name: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
metas.description: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city.

metas.name: Breslau
metas.description: Police officer Franz Podolsky investigates a horrifying murder.

metas.name: The Lost Station Girls
metas.description: Between 1995 and 2001 in southern France, a teenage girl vanishes and three young women are murdered—sparking a relentless manhunt that will haunt detective Flore Robin and the Perpignan police for years.

metas.name: Moonlit Reunion
metas.description: Mei Zhuyu, a calm and reserved nobleman from a lesser branch of the Mei family, arrives in Chang'an as an official at the Bureau of Mystic Investigations. During a banquet, he meets Wu Zhen, the bold and unruly younger sister of the Empress and secret Guardian of the Demon Underworld. Both hide their true identities. Wu, a half-demon striving to keep peace, and Mei, a skilled demon slayer, seek the truth behind the fire 18 years ago. As bone demons rise and unrest grows, they fight side by side, forming a bond that deepens into love until the Changxi Palace launches a purge, forcing them to face each other's secrets and the past they share.

metas.name: The End of an Era
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes docuseries event chronicling the development, impact, and inner workings that created the phenomenon that was Taylor Swift | The Eras Tour, as well as providing an intimate look at Taylor's life as her tour made headlines and thrilled fans around the world. The series also spotlights performers, family members, and friends — including Gracie Abrams, Sabrina Carpenter, Ed Sheeran, and Florence Welch — offering never-before-seen insight into what it took to create a phenomenon.

metas.name: Entrepreneurs
metas.description: Gonzalo, a bar owner's son, keeps failing at nightlife ventures funded by his father. Given one last chance with a new space, he partners with a self-proclaimed guru to open a coworking space, supervised by his sister Julia.

metas.name: Ladrones: la tiara de santa Águeda
metas.description: The professional thief Amber joins a wedding in Isla Esperanza with a target to steal the 24 million euro Tiara of Santa Agueda. It gets a bit more complicated when her previous partner in crime appears with the same agenda

metas.name: Koka björn
metas.description: In the mid-nineteenth century in the village of Kengis, northern Sweden, the body of a shepherd's girl is found in a bog. Soon the villagers set out in search of the killer bear they think is on the rampage.

metas.name: Eyes of Wakanda
metas.description: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

metas.name: Reminder
metas.description: Deniz, a reliable, famous architect, and Güneş, a phenomenal editor, who decided to separate six months ago while on their way to a wedding, are swept into a journey that will change their lives with a message that arrives on their phones on the evening of the day they met by chance. This new adventure will make them discover the missing pieces of their old relationship and remind them of love.

metas.name: Fate
metas.description: Taxi driver David becomes the chauffeur for a famous bullfighter known as El Maestro, who is attempting a comeback after years away from the ring. El Maestro's perspective changes, and he starts seeing David as a good luck charm.

metas.name: Deli Boys
metas.description: When their convenience store-magnate father suddenly dies, a pair of pampered Pakistani American brothers lose everything and are forced to reckon with their Baba's secret life of crime as they attempt to take up his mantle in the underworld.

metas.name: Hyper Knife
metas.description: Seok, an eager yet genius neurosurgeon is reunited with Deokhee, the professor who ruined her life long ago. Once, the two surgeons cared for each other more than anyone else. But now with nothing but hatred toward each other, Seok is furious that he is back in her life and vows to take revenge.

metas.name: Marvel Zombies
metas.description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

metas.name: Daredevil: Born Again
metas.description: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

metas.name: StuGo
metas.description: Six overambitious middle schoolers are tricked into attending a fake academic summer camp by a mad scientist. Now they're stuck for three months on a tropical island with less academia than they'd hoped for but a lot more adventure.

metas.name: Fire and Water: Making the Avatar Films
metas.description: This two-part documentary provides a fascinating glimpse into the making of the Oscar-winning box office phenomenon "Avatar: The Way of Water" and features exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, concept art, and interviews with cast and filmmakers.

metas.name: Harlem Ice
metas.description: Young skaters from Harlem face challenges and triumphs as they train for competitions. Their journey showcases the impact of Figure Skating in Harlem, breaking barriers and opening doors for girls of color in the world of ice skating.

metas.name: Shared Custody
metas.description: Cris and Diego just broke up and agree they want to stay friends. But that gets tricky when they move back in with their parents. The grandparents are eager to treat them like kids again. It doesn't matter that Cris and Diego are over forty years old, or have a five-year-old daughter, Cloe.

metas.name: Disney Twisted-Wonderland: The Animation
metas.description: High school student Yuken is suddenly transported to Twisted Wonderland, a world of magic and wonder. Now, he must face monsters, whimsical magicians-in-training, and mysterious incidents, all without any magic of his own. Will Yu ever find a way back to his own world?

metas.name: The Eighth Family
metas.description: With their invention of bulletproof thermal underwear, the Basmacıgil Family earns the title of the Eighth Family, one of the ruling forces of the world. Yet, as six very different siblings attempt to run the family business, their well-meaning but ineffective efforts leave their father Erol convinced that “no outside enemy is necessary."

metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: Your Friends & Neighbors
metas.description: When a financial titan suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.

metas.name: Murderbot
metas.description: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet... even though it just wants to binge soap operas.

metas.name: Onside: Major League Soccer
metas.description: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season—and gave us a glimpse of the future.

metas.name: The Last Frontier
metas.description: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

metas.name: The Studio
metas.description: Desperate for celebrity approval, the newly appointed head of a movie studio and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

metas.name: The Wild Ones
metas.description: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it's too late.

metas.name: Be@rbrick
metas.description: Jasmine and her band mates fight for their dreams in a society where the painted-on look you get when you graduate from high school determines who you'll be for the rest of your life.

metas.name: Dope Thief
metas.description: Follows long-time friends and delinquents who pose as DEA agents to rob a house in the countryside, but end up unintentionally revealing and unraveling the biggest hidden narcotics corridor on the Eastern seaboard.

metas.name: Chief of War
metas.description: With Hawaii's four kingdoms divided by war, the ferocious warrior Kaʻiana embarks on an epic mission to unite his people—as an existential threat approaches their shores.

metas.name: Love You to Death
metas.description: Raúl's world is unraveling. Marta's unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

metas.name: Long Way Home
metas.description: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan's home in Scotland to Charley's in England. They'll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.

metas.name: Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series
metas.description: Experience the battle of juggernauts like never before as the Yankees and Dodgers revive MLB's most iconic playoff rivalry. With intimate access to superstar players, managers, and their families, witness the sacrifices it takes to claim baseball's throne.

metas.name: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars
metas.description: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world's best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

metas.name: Not a Box
metas.description: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures.

metas.name: Side Quest
metas.description: Go deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in these four standalone stories. Follow the lives of players, comic book shop owners, touring orchestra musicians, and members of the art department as they search for community, success, and love.

metas.name: Goldie
metas.description: Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate—and it's a whole lot of fun.

metas.name: Number One on the Call Sheet
metas.description: Some of Hollywood's biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation's huge potential.

metas.name: The Sisters Grimm
metas.description: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

metas.name: Stick
metas.description: Pryce Cahill was headed for golf greatness when an on-course meltdown derailed his career. Now struggling to stay afloat, he goes all in to mentor Santi—a teenage phenom with immense potential—and maybe save himself.

metas.name: Mr. Scorsese
metas.description: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.

metas.name: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
metas.description: The reunion of old friends, first-person accounts, and rarely seen footage paint an extraordinary and deeply profound picture of what it was like to live through one of history's longest wars.

metas.name: Down Cemetery Road
metas.description: When a child goes missing in the aftermath of a house explosion, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find them. As secrets unravel and a military conspiracy emerges, all hell is unleashed on South Oxford's sleepy suburbs.

metas.name: Smoke
metas.description: A troubled detective and an enigmatic arson investigator pursue the trails of two serial arsonists.

metas.name: Prime Target
metas.description: A brilliant math student is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.

metas.name: Government Cheese
metas.description: When Hampton is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn't quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton's wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.

metas.name: Carême
metas.description: Witness the rise of the world's first celebrity chef, Antonin Carême, and his descent into espionage in Napoleon-era France—where manipulation is king. With his gifts for gastronomy and seduction, he becomes the perfect weapon in a fight for power.

metas.name: Born to Be Wild
metas.description: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.

metas.name: KPOPPED
metas.description: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.

metas.name: Berlin ER
metas.description: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin's toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

metas.name: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle
metas.description: Nina once dreamed of marrying Evan, until betrayal led to divorce and distrust in love. Now his uncle Damon pursues her intensely, though she resists forming ties with her ex's family.

metas.name: Burden of Guilt
metas.description: A woman haunted by her baby brother's mysterious death decades ago discovers she was blamed for the tragedy. Her quest for truth leads to an exhumation that finally reveals what really happened to Matthew.

metas.name: Lil Kev
metas.description: Set in 1993 North Philadelphia, follow 12-year-old Kevin Hart, whose wild imagination and unshakable optimism constantly collide with his neighborhood's harsh realities. At the same time, his no-nonsense mother Nancy juggles night shifts as an E.R. nurse while waging a one-woman war to keep Kev on track – no easy feat with his mischievous older brother Robert blazing all the wrong trails, his trainwreck father Henry's outrageous attempts to win Nancy back, and his ex-con uncle Richard Jr.'s questionable life advice.

metas.name: The Family Business: New Orleans
metas.description: The Duncan Family's underground New Orleans casino find itself in a war after a rival boss's brother dies at the casino. The owner Big Shirley fearing for her son's live sends him away, but he makes his away to New York City seek help from the Duncan crime syndicate instead

metas.name: Little Disasters
metas.description: A group of new mother friends are torn apart when one is accused of injuring her baby, fracturing their bond and nearly destroying their families.

metas.name: NCIS: Tony & Ziva
metas.description: After Ziva's apparent death, Tony raises their daughter Tali. Years later, Ziva returns and reunites with Tony. Tony's company is attacked, and the family travels to Europe to learn who's after them and how to trust each other again.

metas.name: My Nightmare Stalker: The Eva LaRue Story
metas.description: The harrowing true story of how actress Eva LaRue and her daughter Kaya endured 12 years of terror at the hands of a relentless stalker. Operating from the shadows, he taunted and terrorized their lives while his identity remained a mystery, even to the FBI. In this gripping account, Eva reveals the constant fear, emotional toll, and the resolve, courage and resilience it took to protect her family.

metas.name: The Road
metas.description: Blake Shelton and Taylor Sheridan are the executive producers of this show where aspiring artists will compete to become the next big music star while touring with a headlining superstar.

metas.name: Murder 360
metas.description: True crime from every angle. Murder 360 dives deep into motive, method, and psychology with expert analysis, intimate interviews, and gripping cases—from thrill killings to deadly vows.

metas.name: Thirst Trap: The Fame. The Fantasy. The Fallout.
metas.description: When 21-year-old William White posted a lip-synching video to TikTok, he hardly expected to become an internet sensation overnight. Sparking a "thirst trap" obsession with lovesick fans, the line between real connection and online fantasy was blurred as gained millions of fans. What first seemed like innocent interactions with self-formed fan-clubs for White, turned into jealousy, blackmail and betrayal by the fans who were determined to watch his every move online.

metas.name: Reunion
metas.description: Recently released prisoner Daniel Brennan embodies the struggle of a man caught between two worlds, unable to fully integrate into the hearing world and shunned by his closest friends and the wider deaf community following his heinous crime. Amidst this isolation, Brennan's only meaningful relationship is with his estranged daughter Carly, who he has not had any contact with since his arrest over a decade ago.

metas.name: Happy Face
metas.description: The story of Melissa Reed, daughter of Keith Jesperson, aka the Happy Face Killer. After decades of no contact, Keith forces his way back into his daughter’s life, and Melissa must find out if an innocent man is going to be put to death for a crime her father committed. In the process, she must face a reckoning of her own identity.

metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

metas.name: Love You to Death
metas.description: Rebelling against her perfect life, high school senior cheerleader Brooke falls into a hot and heavy romance with transfer student and new QB Nate. Everything seems perfect. Until she discovers that Nate has a very dark side.

metas.name: Super Duper Bunny League
metas.description: A diverse group of bunny friends who work together and use their unique powers to protect their beloved city.

metas.name: Wild Cherry
metas.description: Two pampered teenage daughters. Two very different mothers. The rich life is easy – until a shocking scandal reveals toxic secrets and the ugly side of glamour.

metas.name: Watson
metas.description: A year after the death of his friend and partner Sherlock Holmes, Dr. John Watson resumes his medical career at a clinic dedicated to the treatment of rare diseases. However, he soon finds that his old life is not done with him yet.

metas.name: Boston Blue
metas.description: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

metas.name: The Guest
metas.description: When a cleaner is hired by a wealthy businesswoman, her life changes forever as their initial friendship threatens to become a manipulative, psychological game of cat and mouse.

metas.name: Wylde Pak
metas.description: Lily and Jack are half-siblings thrown together for a summer who must learn how to navigate their new family dynamic while also helping with the Wylde Pak family's chaotic pet grooming business.

metas.name: Jesser: Ball or Nothing
metas.description: Jesser delivers high-energy basketball videos, gaming challenges, and fun content blending sports, skills, and entertainment.

metas.name: Sheriff Country
metas.description: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

metas.name: Bound to the Rebel Wolf
metas.description: Their families slaughtered each other, and they're sworn to hate one another but the pull between them can't be denied. Maeve, the alpha princess, enters Luperiom determined to survive the kingdom's brutal war college.

metas.name: Ghosts: Australia
metas.description: Kate inherits a haunted mansion and gains the ability to see ghosts. With her partner Sean, she plans to convert it into a boutique hotel, unaware of the spirits' presence and their potential impact on their lives.

metas.name: Beyond the Gates
metas.description: A powerful and prestigious family reigns over a posh gated community with juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered.

metas.name: Undiscovered Vistas
metas.description: Across the globe lie a number of little-known, breathtaking natural settings. Get acquainted with these areas of outstanding natural beauty, their native wildlife, and the unique historical forces that shape them.

metas.name: Crutch
metas.description: Francois 'Frank' Crutchfield or 'Crutch' to those who know him well, is a Harlem widower whose empty-nest plans are put on hold after his millennial son and free-spirited daughter move back home.

metas.name: Don't Date Brandon
metas.description: Two women discover they dated the same deceptive man they met online. After launching a podcast about their experiences with Brandon, more victims emerge, revealing a pattern of manipulation and dark secrets.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

metas.name: Liberation: D-Day to Berlin
metas.description: Experience the liberation of Western Europe from every angle, as astonishingly colourised and expertly restored footage bring the historic turning point of World War II back to vivid life.

metas.name: Hollywood Squares
metas.description: Two contestants play tic-tac-toe to win money and prizes. The "board" for the game is a vertical stack of open-faced cubes, each occupied by a celebrity seated at a desk and facing the contestants. The celebrities are asked questions and the contestants judge the legitimacy of their answers to win the game.

metas.name: Hip Hop Was Born Here
metas.description: Hosted by legendary rapper LL COOL J, the series will chart the creation, evolution and ongoing legacy of hip-hop not just as a genre but as a culture.

metas.name: DMV
metas.description: Follows a workplace comedy set in the dreaded DMV office, following quirky minimum-wage employees who make the best of dealing with annoyed customers, finding solace in each other's company.

metas.name: The Carters: Hurts to Love You
metas.description: Unravel a deeply disturbing path told by Angel Conrad, Nick and Aaron Carter's sister, along with first-time interviews with friends Melissa Joan Hart and Scout Willis. Never-before-seen home movies that detail the brothers' rise to fame and the devastating toll it took on their family also help tell the Carters’ story.

metas.name: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas
metas.description: Seven years ago, they shared one night. Now they're fake-married - with a child he doesn't know is his.

metas.name: Coldwater
metas.description: A man in the midst of a mid-life crisis moves his family to a remote Scottish village, only to find himself entangled in a dangerous friendship with a sinister neighbour.

metas.name: Alphabet Soup
metas.description: The unfiltered reality of queer dating in NYC, where raw emotions, intimate texts and authentic relationships unfold without scripts or filters.

metas.name: The Unknown Serial Killers of America
metas.description: Lesser-known but equally lethal killers are revealed through interviews with police and victims' contacts, showing how these murderers stayed undetected while continuing their deadly sprees.

metas.name: Older Hotter Wiser
metas.description: A young woman is ready to take on Hollywood, but first, she must get there. When a logistical mishap forces her and her boyfriend onto a chaotic road trip to LA, what starts as a simple journey spirals into a wild ride filled with unexpected detours, mischief, and a reckoning with her past.

metas.name: The Hunting Party
metas.description: A small team of investigators are assembled to track down and capture the most dangerous killers our country has ever seen, all of whom have just escaped from a top-secret prison that's not supposed to exist.

metas.name: Wife Swap: The Real Housewives Edition
metas.description: A a member of The Real Housewives who must "take off her stilettos and step into a real housewife's shoes."

metas.name: Adaptive
metas.description: A profile of the personal and professional lives of world-class Paralympic athletes, highlighting the power of sport through community and advocacy.

metas.name: Team Mekbots: Animal Rescue
metas.description: Four animal-loving kids from around the world use their tech skills to create giant Mekbots – each inspired by a different animal.

metas.name: The Kouncil
metas.description: Katie Florence is picking up the pieces after a crushing breakup. Living alone for the first time, she relies on her personified inner council to guide her through the chaos of adulthood. Logic pushes for rational decisions, Heart longs for love, Anxiety anticipates every possible disaster and Lady Parts has her own agenda. As Katie navigates friendships, romance, career setbacks and self-worth, she constantly battles between doing what she wants and what she needs. With humor, vulnerability and occasional self-sabotage, Katie learns that growing up means accepting every part of herself -- even the messy ones.

metas.name: Love Island: Beyond the Villa
metas.description: Following everyone’s favorite Season 6 Islanders around Los Angeles as they navigate new careers, evolving friendships, newfound fame, and complex relationships outside of the Love Island villa.

metas.name: The Chrisleys: Back to Reality
metas.description: As the Chrisley siblings adapt to life with their parents behind bars, Savannah juggles raising her younger siblings and seeking justice, while Chase tackles personal challenges and a new business venture.

metas.name: The Rainmaker
metas.description: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

metas.name: All Her Fault
metas.description: When her son vanishes after a play date at the park, a mother is thrust into a desperate search to uncover the truth behind his disappearance.

metas.name: Long Bright River
metas.description: A Philadelphia police officer searches for her sister, an addict who has gone missing.

metas.name: Bravo's Love Hotel
metas.description: Real Housewives stars Shannon Beador, Gizelle Bryant, Ashley Darby, and Luann de Lesseps visit Los Cabos' Grand Velas Hotel to find love among eligible bachelors.

metas.name: People Like Me
metas.description: People Like Me follows a guy navigating the pitfalls of being human. Struggling with anxiety, relationships, and self-doubt, he turns to his therapist for guidance. Through their sessions, he learns to embrace life’s unpredictability, often in unexpected ways; sometimes through song, sometimes through dance, and always with humor. As he stumbles through friendships, heartbreaks, and personal growth, he discovers that life’s chaos isn’t something to be feared but something to be played with. With each misstep, he inches closer to understanding himself, realizing that being human isn’t about having all the answers; it’s about embracing the journey, no matter how ridiculous it gets.

metas.name: The Gilgo Beach Killer: House of Secrets
metas.description: Inside the home of the alleged Gilgo Beach killer, featuring exclusive family testimony revealing a double life and dark secrets hidden beneath their roof after his arrest.

metas.name: Nelly and Ashanti: We Belong Together
metas.description: A couple rekindles their romance while handling marriage, parenthood, and careers. They face challenges together, showing how love gets a second chance.

metas.name: The Real Housewives of London
metas.description: A reality series that gives an exclusive look and follows the lives of unique, interesting and dynamic women from London and their lavish lifestyles.

metas.name: High Horse: The Black Cowboy
metas.description: Three-part pop culture and historical documentary confronts and reclaims the Wild West while revealing the story of the Black cowboy — a history that has largely been untold.

metas.name: Unconventional
metas.description: Unconventional is a bold, hilarious, and deeply authentic look at modern queer life. Created by six-time Emmy nominee Kit Williamson (EastSiders, Mad Men), this irreverent comedy follows Noah Guillory (Williamson), a queer millennial juggling a decade-long marriage, the uncertainty of fatherhood, and the chaos of academia—all while acting as a sperm donor for his sister’s wife.

metas.name: The Death Investigator with Barbara Butcher
